tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil chog nag po

lugs kyi gsal byed bde ba chen po'i char yangs bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon chen po spyod pa pa'i lugs kyi lag len gsal byed bde ba chen po'i char yangs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan lhan cig skyes pa'i gzhal med khang na mchog tu dga' ba'i 'bar 'phreng me chen rtag tu 'khrugs/ /ma lus bdud sde'i snying khrag rgya mtsho zhal du rngubs shing drag po sder bcas rdul phran phung por bshig /zhing gi rdul snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyis bskor bde chen rtse dga' byed pa'i rol pa 'dzin/ /bdag med mi zad dur khrod chen por shes rab mtshan rgyu'i tshogs pas legs btud he ru ka dpal la phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig sgoms na mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la 'bad med par/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la ngo mtshar cher skyes nas/ /blo rmongs bdag kyang gnas 'dir rtsol bar gyur/ /nag po spyod pa'i bzhed gzhung rdo rje'i tshig / grub pa'i gnas thob bye bas mngon sgrod pa/ /lam 'di ma nor gsal bar rtogs pa 'ga'/ /dus mthar 'byung ba 'di yang rgyal ba'i mthu/ /'grel bshad 'khyam po bltas pa'i blo gros kyis/ /grub pa'i thugs bcud longs pa ga la zhig /rgya gzhung yin zhes paṇa chung 'ga' zhig gi/ gzhung la mchog 'dzin byed pa'ang byis pa'i tshul/ /blun po rang gi de nyid rton pa la/ /zab don mthar thug yin zhes skal dman 'khrul/ /grub pa'i dgongs bzhed rdo rje 'chang gi lam/ /smin byed dbang gi chu bo 'di na ko /de la 'dir de kho na nyid bcu ste/ snyen pa gsol gdabs sa chog dang*/ /sta gon dkyil 'khor dri ba dang*/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub dang mchod bdag 'jug /dbang bskur rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /de ltar na sngon du bsnyen pa'i bya ba/ gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa/ sa gzhi lhag par gnas pa/ lha slob sta gon gnas pa/

gzugs brnyan 'dri ba'i rnam gzhag / dkyil 'khor rnam gsum sgrub pa mchod pa rgyas pa'i cho ga / 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ gzhug cing dbang bskur ba/ nyer bsdu rjes kyi lag len no/ /dang po bsnyen pa'i bya ba ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon du 'gyur bas dang por bdag nyid byin gyis rlabs pa'i don du rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa bya ste/ lha'i rnal 'byor la cung zad sems brtan pa dang*/ rnam par g.yeng ba spangs pa'i sgo nas/ ji skad du mngon brjod las/ sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ /cho ga bzhin du 'bum du bzla/ /'khor lo'i gsang sngags 'bum bzlas zhing*/ /gzhan ni khri ru bzlas par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ rgyud gzhan las kyang de ltar gsungs pa dang dbang po rnon pos khri phrag gis kyang 'grub par 'gyur la/ bzhi 'gyur gyi bsnyen pa lan gsum rtsom pa sogs bya zhing*/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i sngags gnyis kyang snga ma'i bcu cha bzla ste/ bzlas pa'i bcu cha sbyin sreg kyang bya'o/ /da ltar rtsod pa'i dus kyi tha ma ste/ gnas skabs 'di dag tu yang bye ba'am bye ba lnga bzlas shing*/ sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bcu byas pas ni/ nges par byin gyis brlabs pas nus pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyis slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i dus na/ lha la gnang ba zhu ba'i don gyi bsnyen pa la ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po khri phrag gsum/ 'khor lo gsum la khri phrag gnyis te/ ma mo bcu gnyis la lnga stong lnga brgya re bzla ba rgyas pa dang*/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi bzlas pa spangs pa'i 'bring po dang*/ gtso bo yab yum kho na bzlas pa bsdus pa'o/ /de dag tu gtor ma dang mchod pa yang nas yang du phul te/ slob ma'i don du gsol ba btab pas/ rmi lam la sogs par snang ba rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gnang ba thob na ye shes dbab pa'i rdzas byin gyis brlab pa'i bsnyen pa yang bya'o/ /gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa ni slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul te/

rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i bstan pa legs gnas pa/ /bde mchog cho ga bshad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol btab/ slob dpon gyis/ 'khor lo mchod pa'i rim ji bzhin/ khyod kyi thams cad 'byor gyur ram/ /rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor pa/ /gus pas dga' bar byed nus sam/ zhes dris pa la/ 'byor gyur te/ zhes dang*/ byed nus so/ / zhes lan gdab bo/ yang 'di skad du/ dam tshig skyong zhing brtan byed pa/ /bu khyod kyis ni spro gyur tam/ zhes pa la/ bdag ni rab tu spro gyur to/ / zhes lan btab bo/ skabs 'dir slob ma la bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyangs pa byas pa'i rjes su sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar srung 'khor sgom/ zhal bzhi pa bzlas pa'i srung skud mgul bar btags/ smon lam dang shis brjod bya'o/ /gsum pa sa gzhi lhag par gnas pa la/ sa gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ sa sbyang ba/ sa bslang ba/ sa bzung ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni spyi dang 'dra zhing gzhung du'ang lta'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rko sbyang dang stegs bu bya ba yin la/ de ltar ma grub na/ oṃ bhu khāṃ/ zhes sogs te spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa sngon du btang nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/ thun mtshams dag pa gsum dran pa'i bar bdag bskyed sgrub thabs ltar rdzogs par sgom/ sa gnon gyis phyag rgyas sor mo dbus ma gsum sa la reg ste/ ḍāk+ki ni hūṃ dza oṃ haṃ/ lan gsum/ haṃ gi sgra dang hūṃ gi 'od kyis bskul nas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa byung*/ tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni/ sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bgyi ba bka' stsal du gsol/

zhes gsungs par gyur/ bdag bskyed ltar mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ praṃ thi wī de wī bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha swāhā/ mtshan sngags te sngon du 'gro ba'i/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta/ ghan+ḍe/ sogs rol mo/ gtor ma/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ pri thi wī de wī bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni/ /lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma/ /do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mchod gtor 'di dag mchod nas su/ /dkyil 'khor las ni legs grub mdzod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gsol/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo yi/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor bri/ lan gsum/ sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod gtor dam pa 'dis tshim par mdzod la/ bdag gi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i dpang po mdzad cing*/ dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i don du sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa sa gzhi bgegs med cing dag par bya ba'i las ci bde bar mdzod cig oṃ pri thi wī de wī bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ bzhi pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka thugs dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa dang*/

bdud kyi sde la sogs pa sdang ba dang gdug pa can dang gdul dka' ba'i sems can rnams rab tu sdigs par mdzad pa rab tu 'khrugs shing cher khros la bzhad pa'i nyams can/ sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spro ba dang bcas par gyur/ mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla bar gyur/ mig 'bras hūṃ las rdo rje nag po khro bo'i tshogs kyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ rkang mthil gnyis su āḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /ba dz+ra driṣ+ta ma ṭa/ rdo rje lta bas g.yas g.yon du bskos te bltas pas bgegs bskrad/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'gying ba dang bcas pas 'di skad ces/ sa'i phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don rtsom gyi/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dngo srin po dang srin mo la sogs pa/ gang dag gnas pa'i sa'i bdag po myur du song shig /'dir dpal he ru ka'i bka' nos la myur ba nyid song shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de la nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rje dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dis/ spyi bo nas rnam pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o/ / lan gsum/ re re'imathar sum+bha bzlas shing*/ 'bud dkrol bya/ nyung dkar gyis sa gzhi la gtor ro/ /de nas hūṃ glur len zhing dbang ldan du song la/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang*/ rtse gsum pa dang*/ rtse lnga pa'i 'gros kyis bskor ba dang*/ rol pa'i skyong ba dang bstun nas/ dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje 'bri shing mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dang*/ shar du g.yon rkyang*/ byang du sa ga/ nub tu zlum po/ lhor g.yas brkyang rnams thabs shes kyi dbye bas brgyad dam bcur 'gyur ba dang*/ gyen du 'degs pa dang*/ thur du skyod pa dang*/ thad dkar skyod pa gsum gyis bskor zhing*/ g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ 'khyud dang ku tsa nyed pa dang*/ na ga gra ha da na da ka dang*/ tsū sha na dang skra grol ba/ zhes brgyad dang*/ rkang pa skyod dang lag pa skyod/ /smin ma ldeg dang rab rgyas brang*/

/cung zad ngo tsha'i zur mig dang*/ /rla rgyus blta na sdug pa dang*/ /mig yangs gar ni byed 'gyur zhing*/ /kha yi pad+ma 'dzum pa dang*/ /cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang*/ /kun da ltar dkar so yi 'phreng*/ /zhes pa ltar gar gyi rnam par rol pa rnams bya zhing*/ stangs stabs kyi spros pa la mi dga' na/ ji ltar rigs pa'i skor ba gsum bya'o/ /srung ba ni/ dngos su phur bu med na yid kyis btab pas kyang rung la/ dngos su yod na/ phur pa bcu 'am lnga gdab pa gang rigs pas bcu'i phyogs la bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ steng dang shar gyi phur bu khwa gdong ma sngo ser/ byang gi phur bu 'ug gdong ma ljang ser/ nub dang 'og gi phur bu khyi gdong ma dmar ser/ zhes pa nas/ byang shar gyi phur bu gshin rje 'jom pa g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo chen mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can no/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'i phaiṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ sum+bha mang du bzla'o/ /mthar yi ge brgya pa dang brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas zhal bzhi pa'i sngags tshar gcig brjod / sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad sprul/ khwa gdong ma las steng du khā gdong ma/ zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par gyur/ gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod pa las/ phur gdab dang phur bu brdungs ba'i sngags tshar bcu bcu brjod/ phur bu yod na dngos su yang gdab brdung bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra āḥhūṃ/ rdo rje sdams pa sa la bzhag aḥ yig las skyes pa'i sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ badz+ra driṣ+ti ma ṭa/ rdo rje'i lta bas g.yas g.yon du skor zhing ltas pas/ rdo rje'i bla bre gur mda'i dra ba me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri bha wa ban+dha hūṃ/ sogs/ sngags drug po tshar gsum gsum brjod/ sum tshan re re'i mthar/

oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bcu'am bzhi la sogs pa brjod/ phur bu dang de srung ba'i pho nya rnams la/ ar+gha la sogs pas mchod/ phur bu la dri'i byugs pas byugs me tog 'phreng ba dmar po dang mgul bcings dmar po dang*/ yungs dkar gyi thum bu rnams mgul du btags gu gul gyis bdugs te/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe mā li/ bas+t+ra/ sarga pa/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūṃ/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs thams cad bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces gsol ba btab/ de dag gi mthar smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /phur bu lnga pa'i phyogs la hūṃ lnga las/ dbus kyi phur bu gnod mdzes nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ oṃ sum+bha ra dza badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍal la tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ shar lho'i phur bu mi g.yo ba nag po ral gri dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ oṃ ka nī dhu ni badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lho nub kyi phur bu dbyug sngon can dbyug pa sngon po dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ oṃ nī la daṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā maṇ+ḍal tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nub byang gi phur bu rta mgrin dmar po dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ oṃ ha ya gṝ ba badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ byang shar gyi phur bu bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuḍa li badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa la tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ thams cad kyang lte ba man chad phur bu rtse gcig pa 'bar ba'i rnam pas/ bgegs thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ / zhes bskyed pa dang*/ phur gdab dngos kyi skabs/ mtshams ma bzhi pos phur bus gdab pa dang*/ sgo ma bzhi pos tho bas brdungs par bsam/ dbus kyi phur bu ni stegs bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i nang ngam/

khang steng du dkyil 'khor 'bri na de'i thad ka'i 'og tu 'debs pa yin kyang*/ phal cher dbus su btab par mos nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs thag nye bar 'debs/ steng 'og gi bgegs la dbus kyi phur bus 'debs shing*/ shar dang shar lho'i bgegs sdoms nas shar lhor phur bu 'debs pa sogs yin pas/ hūṃ las byung ba'i khron pa lngar gyur/ zhes 'don pa spo dgos la/ cho ga lhag ma thams cad snga ma bzhin no/ /grub chen gyi dkyil chog las phur gdab tsam zhig gsung pa ma gtogs phur bu'i lha gang yin dngos su mi gsal yang mkha' 'gro ma brgyad don gyi thob la/ khro bo lnga ni gzhung tshig gi dngos shugs gang la'ang mi gsal mod slob dpon 'di'i bzhed pa'i rnam grangs su yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig snang ngo*/ /bzhi pa lha slob sta gon gnas pa la/ sta gon gyi snga rol du sgrub dgos pa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon dngos so/ /dang po ni sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ zhu 'bul dkyil 'khor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /de yang sngon 'gro gtor ma/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes byin gyis rlabs/ phaiṃ/ zhes mgron rnams spyan drangs/

oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ nas/ bha wān+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyi mchod/ lha yi tshogs rnams nas/ 'dod pa kun grub shogadapal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs su gsol te/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma la sogs pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnams bzlog cing 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /sum bha bzlas drag rol bya gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ sum bhas bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūṃ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan dhe/ nai we te/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra s+phā ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsā li te/ prā dzñā pa ra mi ta/ na da sam bha we ta/ badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes rol mo byin 'bebs kyi sngags dang*/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzlas shing byin dbab bo/ /zhu 'bul ni/ tshogs pa yod na tshogs kyi gtso bo la gsol ba gdab pa'i don yin pas byas na legs par 'gyur te/ byed tshul ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ zhing sbyongs dag pa gsum gyi bar du bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor rgyas pa nyid rdzogs par bsgom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sta gon dngos la/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyis cho ga byas zin na/ sa'i lha mo'i sta gon ni mi dgos te/ gzhung las mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang ras bris la brten pa'i phyogs sam/ rdul tshon la brten pa yin kyang rung ste/ sa chog ma byas na 'dir byed dgos te/ gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba las/ gsol gdab tshig lhug pa de bor/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar mdzod cig ces snang ba sbyin par bsams pa ni khyad par ro/ dkyil 'khor khang pa rnying par rdul tshon la brten pa la yang sa chog med pa'i cho ga la/ gnas gsar rab ras bris la yang sa chog byung na legs te/ de ni sa gzhi la dkyil 'khor bri ba kho na'i phyir ma yin gyi/

phyi nang gi bdud dang bar chad gzhom pa'i phyir yin pas so/ /zhes pa ni bdag gi rnam par rtog pa ste bod kyi bla ma rnams ras bris kyi phyogs la sa chog mi byed cing phyis byung mang po zhig ni lha gnas kyang mi byed par snang ngo*/ /'dir sta gon ni rnam pa gnyis te/ lha'am dkyil 'khor lhag par gnas pa dang*/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ shar dang steng gi phur bu khā gdong ma/ nas/ phur bu'i dbyibs can du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe nas/ bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig gi bar gong bzhin nam yang khro bo'i phur bu lnga pa dang yod na/ dbus kyi phur bu gnod mdzes nag po/ nas/ yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe nas/ mdzod cig gi bar gong bzhin no/ /phur bu skyed cing mchod pa ni/ sa chog ma byas na lha sta gon gyi gong du nges par bya la/ sa chog byas na slar skyed chog mi dgos par gu gul gyis bdugs phyi mchod ci nus re phul nas gsol ba btab/ gtor bsngo'i zhor la gtor ma phul ba tsam gyis chog par mngon no/ /de nas rdul tshon gyi phyogs la thig rags pa tsam 'ol spyi tsam skam thig gi tshul du btab la/ dri bzang dang khrag cher sbyar bas/ gtso bo'i gnas su gru bzhi che ba dang*/ 'khor gyi gnas su zlum po chung ba re byugs dgos shing*/ ras bris la ni stegs bu'am maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu bkod pa tsam gyis chog go /de'i mtha' mchod gtor gyis skor/ pu dza o a go rā de mā/ kā o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pri gri sau su na si ma ku/ zhes lan gsum brjod skabs rdo rje sdams pas stengs nas kha sbub/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ lha thams cad kyi snying po tshar gsum gsum dang*/ thod pa bzhi dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan sum cu so drug brjod de sa gzhi byin rlabs dang tshom bu dgod pa'i cho ga'o/

/de nas de rnams sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo/ nā da las byung ba'i hūṃ yig nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las byung ba'i srung 'khor gzhal yas khang nyi zla dang bcas pa rim gyi grub par gyur pa ni/ 'og tu paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams= nas/ bar du gcod pa thams cad srung bar mdzad kyi/ bar sgrubs thabs bzhin/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du= nas/ de'i dbus su lung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po nas/ thig le ser po dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du/ bh+ruṃ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nas/ 'khor rnams la mi ro'i gdan rnams su gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du g.yon bskor gyi a ā/ nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du nam mkha'i hūṃ yig zhugs/ hūṃ dang aṃ las nas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bde ba chen po'i 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nas/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar mkha' nang du dkyil 'khor bskyed pa bzhin no/ / rang gi snying gis hūṃ yig nas phaiṃ/ gyi bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ye shes spyan 'dren bzhin dang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa'i phyi mchod phul/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'i nang mchod phul/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ yo ga shud+dha 'i sngags dang phyag rgya bya de nyid byin gyis rlabs pa'i don du/ lha thams cad kyi snying po tshar gcig brjod/ de nas dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur ba yang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang 'dra ba las bdag la zhes 'don pa spo'o/

/de nas mchod pa ni lha so so'i snying po re re'i mthar mchod sngags re re bzhin btags nas/ mchod pa 'bul ba gzhung gi bshad tshod yin zhing*/ don la'ang de bzhin dgos pas 'grub na de ltar bya la de ltar mi lcogs na/ thog mar sngags mchod tsam song ba'i rjes su/ mchod pa rnams spyi mthun du phul na rung tsam gyi dbang du byas nas/ deng sang gi lag len ltar na/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis rlabs la/ 'og dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar 'bul ba las/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyi phyi mchod dang*/ rig ma bcu drug nang mchod dang*/ gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa rnams chad na mi rung la/ gzhan rnams rgyas bsdus skabs dang mtshams par bya zhing*/ gtor ma gsol gdab kyi rjes su 'bul ba dang*/ 'jig rten 'das gtor skabs 'dir phul/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma snyan gsan dbab pa'i rjes su 'bul ba'i lugs dang*/ gtor chog yongs rdzogs skabs 'dir byed pa'i lugs te/ gsum po gang ltar byas kyang don gyi gtso bo 'grub pa la khyad med kyang*/ gzhung gi dgongs pa phyi ma ltar yin pas skabs 'dir bya ste/ sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma byin gyis rlabs/ dkyil 'khor spyan 'dren mi dgos pas phaiṃ zhes mgron rnams spyan 'dren lhag ma 'dod don gsol 'debs kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin yin pa las/ 'jig rten 'das gtor gyi 'jug tu phur bu'i lha la dmigs nas/ sum+bha 'i mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ nag po chen po sogs sgos kyi chos skyong 'ga' la gtor ma 'bul ba spro na'ang 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor chog gnyis kyi bar du 'bul/ de nas snyan gsan dbab pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bdud rtsi lnga dang sha chen sbyar ba'i bdug spos snod dang bcas pa thogs te/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/

/phag mo lhan cig yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*/ /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma la ni phan pa dang*/ /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can dag 'di zhes pas/ /nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyis byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ / lan gsum/ de nas mchod pa kha gsos la/ sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis rlabs/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ yid byung rnams kyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi bzod par gsol/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams bdag gi snying gar bzhugs la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba chen po mdzad de/ nang par dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad/ rang rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying khar thim/ go cha gsum gyis rgyas btab/ sum+bha lan gnyis kyis phyogs bcings/ zhing sbyong dag pa gsum dran par bya/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /'on kyang gzhung gi dgongs pa ni/ snyan gsan dbab pa grub pa na/ smon lam dang bkra shis byas nas/ de nyid rjes chog ma byas par/ nyi ma de nyid kyi 'phros dang de'i mtshan mo la/ mchod pa rgya cher phul/ yol ba la sogs pas sgribs te bzhag go /nang par thig tshon byin rlabs byed khar/ rjes chog rnams byed pa yin te/ gzhung gzhan phal cher las kyang 'di bzhin tu 'byung ngo*/ /mtshan mo mchod pa'i rgyun sogs mi lcogs na/ phyis bod rnams lag len byed pa/ lha sta gon gyi cho ga grub ma thag tu rjes chog byed pa 'di nyid legs so/

/gnyis pa slob ma sta gon ni/ zhi bas sbyang ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang drag po'i sbyang ba ste/ bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ til sbyang gi sdig pa sbyang ba gnyis/ sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas sta gon gyi chos bcu gsum bya ste/ bsam pa brtan dang bu ru sgrub/ /gsol gdab sngags kyi che ba brjod/ /sdom bzung lhar bskyed mchod pa 'bul/ /srung skud khyor chu so shing dang*/ ku sha zab mo'i chos bshad cing*/ /rmi lam brtags te ngan na srung*/ /zhes bya ste/ de yang slob ma rnams 'dus pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa/ slob ma bur sgrub pas/ gsol ba btab pa/ gsang sngags la spro ba skyed pa/ sdom pa bzung ba/ lhar bskyed pa/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ srung skud bcing ba/ khyor chu so shing*/ ku sha sbyin pa/ zab mo'i chos bshad pas spro ba bskyed pa/ rmi lam brtags cing ngan na srung ba ste/ chos bcu gsum las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug bya ste/ /bsod nams 'dod pa'i de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya ste/ /'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /ces brjod de don yang bshad do/ / gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkha' nang du gnas par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zhal du zhugs/

byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te dag pa'i shel ltar gyur pa/ mkha' nang nas phyir 'phros te/ pad+ma'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rdo rje phag mos mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / zhes slob mas lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ bzhi pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ /khyed la yang dag bshad par bya/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*/ /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*/ /da ltar 'byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyin bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /

ces brjod kyang don bshad/ lnga pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum rjes bzlogs byar bcug ste/ thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du ni slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par srung*/ zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ngo*/ /drug pa ni/ slob ma he ru ka phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du/ slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yon gyis khrag gam/ de sbyar du mi 'dod na khrag chen po gnyis dang bdud rtsi lnga sogs byin gyis brlab pa'i nang mchod dang bsres pas dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su thig le byas te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum byung*/ yang snying mgrin dpral ba rnams su reg ste hūṃ āḥ.oṃ/ snying gar thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje/ dpral par sku rdo rje rnams su gyur/ yang dpral ba nas mar reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum gyi sku gsum thugs rdo rje la thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gyur/ yi ge bdun pa mang du bzlas te/ slob ma'i lus kyi cha thams cad la gtor zhing*/ mig la sogs pa dbang po'i sgo thams cad la yang*/

slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon bdud rtsi dang bcas pa de nyid kyis reg cing srung bar bya'o/ /lus kyi cha thams cad lha'i rdul phra rab tu gyur pas srung ba byas par mos/ bdun pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lngas slob ma la mchod/ brgyad pa ni bsrung skud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad bu dmar po/ rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum dang bcas pa/ bar chad srung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ye shes kyi srad bu phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yi ge brgya pa dang sum+bha spel ba bzla zhing*/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su bcing ngo*/ /nang mchod nas kyang gtor la rdo rje rgya gram du reg pas/ go bskon par mos/ dgu pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā sarba pā paṃ ni tsa a s+ye saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpā na a pa nā ya hūṃ/ ces pas lan gsum gyis khyor chu blud/ bcu pa ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin so shing dang rtse mo la srad bu dmar po dang me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa/ dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ sum+bha bzla bzhin du sbyin/ des kyang*/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes drang por dor la/ slob dpon gyis dngos grub lung ston no/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa/ rmi lam mi 'khrugs par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ dhīḥ zhes ku sha chung ba g.yas dang*/ hā zhes che ba g.yon du gtad/ bcu gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/

/bskal ba bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas pas smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros brtan zhing mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i/ / bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal pa chen po la/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ / ces brjod cing don bshad/ bcu gsum pa ni/ rmi lam dge ba'am mi dge ba/ /nang par nga la rab tu smros/ ces dang*/ do nub ku sha'i sngas gdan la/ seng ge'i nyal stabs dang*/ dge ba'i sems kyis nyol zhig de las rmi lam gyi mtshan ma bzang ngan dag mthong bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes brjod/ slob ma rnams kyi lus la go cha gnyis dgod pa'i dmigs pa tsam slob dpon gyis byas te/ dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*/ /slob ma'am slob dpon la rmi lam mi dge ba dag byung na zlog pa'i thabs ni/ bgegs la phur bus gdab pa dang*/ zhi ba'am drag po'i sbyin sreg dang*/ gtor ma chen po'i cho ga la sogs pa bya ste/ ci ste de dag bya bar ma lcogs na/ sgyu ma lta bur shes pas bzlog par bya'o/ /'di'i lugs la bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa'i yo byad tshogs par byas pa tsam zhig yin pas/ cho ga sogs pa mi bzhed do/

/lnga pa gzugs brnyan 'bri ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi zhag gi bya ba zhes kyang bya ste/ 'di la gsum thig gdab pa dang*/ tshon dbye ba dang*/ rgyan dang yo byad dgod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sta gon gyi nyi ma'i 'jug de nyid la/ 'di byed na bdag bskyed gsar du len mi dgos mod/ dkyil chog thams cad kyi dgongs pas nyin zhag so sor byed pa yin pas 'dir lus dkyil dang bcas pa'i bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig sgom mo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sa la sum+bha bzlas pa'i dri bzang gi chus gtor rang dang grogs gtso bo yab yum du gsal bas/ lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga dang ldan pa'i thig skud 'du byas la/ mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ thugs skud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ dbus su hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum mā ma kī la 'khyud pa/ shar du bruṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/ 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma la 'khyud pa/ byang du aṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/ rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma la 'khyud pa/ nub tu dz+riṃ las 'od dpag med dmar mo/ pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo la 'khyud pa/ lhor khaṃ las don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgrol ma la 'khyud pa rnam snang zla ba dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rigs lnga ni stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa/ yum rnams sku mdog yab dang mtshungs shing gri khug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dbu skra grol ba/ thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral par oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis nas/ ye shes sems dpa' rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/

gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ/ oṃ a kā ro sogs kyi gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pa'am/ rigs lnga'i bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod/ de la de nyid lnga pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ / rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ / pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pa'o/ / rigs lnga yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud rnam pa lngar gyur/ de rin po che'i snod du bzhag sangs rgyas thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs te thig skud la yang yang stim zhing*/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po mang du bzlas la byin gyis rlabs cing*/ khrag chen dang*/ gzhon nu ma'i rngul dang bdud rtsi lnga dang tsan+da la sogs pas byug yab yum gyi rtsa sngags bzla bzhin du bskyangs la/ sku gsung thugs kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo'i sngags bzla bzhin du lnga tshan lnga tshan las mthar gcig tu sgril/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmāḥpa ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+taḥsarba dharmā at+yan ta a nu pra biṣ+taḥsarba dharmāḥhūṃ/ zhes pa'ang lag len la bzla bar snang bas cung zad bzla/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su pra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/

zhes bzla bzhin du grogs la gtad la/ dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes brjod/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i dus ni 'di yin no/ / ces dang po nam mkha' dang de nas sa la gdab bo/ de yang byang lho nub shar tshangs thig ste/ me rlung srin dbang zur thig go /rtse mo can dang 'byung pos shar/ gtsug phud can dang mtshan rgyu'i lho/ /g.yo byed srung bas nub kyi ste/ /rta dmar grags po'i byang du'o/ /dang po slob dpon phyi ma grogs g.yon nas bskor ba'i rim pa bya/ rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor la ni/ shin tu go skabs mi bden ma gtogs/ 'jig rten pa'i lho la dkyil 'khor gyi shar lta bar bya la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la ni nges pa med do/ /de nas phyogs thams cad rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du shes par byas nas/ de'i rjes su las thig gdab ste/ ji skad du gzhung las/ sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ /khyams ni de yi phyed du bya/ /sgo 'khyud dag ni sgo yi tshad/ /lha yi snam bu'i tshad de bzhin/ /mtshams kyi thig ni bskor ba dag /rta babs kyi ni gnas su bshad/ ces 'byung ngo*/ /phyi'i khor yug bskor tshul ni/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor nang du ni/ /rim gnyis thig ni gdab par bya/ zhes sgyur ba ltar na/ rdo rje'i rwa ba chen po dang*/ 'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje ste rwa ba chung ngu gsum gyi thig gdab pa ston par 'gro yang*/ mar pa do ba'i 'gyur las/ khor yug gi ni mthar thug par/ /rdo rje'i 'phreng bas sngon bskor te/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' ma ste/ /slob dpon gnyis 'gyur thig gdab bya/ /tshon gyi sa ni de yi phyed/ /rtsa ba'i thig gi phyogs gnas su'o/ /zhes 'byung ba dag par mngon pas/ rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ dur khrod dang 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la dgongs par gsal lo/ /nang gi thig ni/ de yi nang du pad+ma ste/ /pad+ma'i rgyab tu 'khor lo bya/

/rdo rje'i thig ni gnyis po der/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba'i bskor bar bya/ /'khor lo gsum ni cha chen por/ /rdo rje'i thig gis bskor bar bya/ /ge sar dang bcas pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma bcu drug dag tu gnas/ zhes gsungs te/ rtsa thig gi nang du phyogs re rer cha chen bzhi bzhi yod pa las/ bzhi pa rang sor bzhag na 'dab ma gsum po cha gsum du bgos pas dgur 'gyur ba las/ dang po bskor bas pad+ma'i lte ba/ gnyis pas gtso bo'i gnas kyi pad 'dab gsum pas mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i pad 'dab/ lnga pa bdun pa dgu pa rnams bskor bas/ 'khor lo gsum gyi phyi mtha'/ dang po/ gsum pa/ lnga pa/ bdun pa/ dgu pa rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi drug cha bskor bas ge sar dang mu khyud bzhi'o/ /'khor lo gsum gyi rtsibs rnams zhing che sar yang dkyus dang mnyam mo/ /thig gi bya ba spyi ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /yang 'di skad du/ dang por rdo rgyus thig sogs te/ /thig rnams thams cad nges par bya/ /de yi steng du ye shes thig /kun nas yongs su rkyang bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar na/ dang por las thig btab la de byin gyis brlab pa'i don du ye thig 'debs pa'o/ /de yang rgyas bshad kyi skabs su ye thig sngon la gsungs la/ don bsdus skabs su las thig thog mar gsungs pa ni/ 'dam khar dgongs pa yin zhing*/ ye thig de nyid kyis las thig 'debs par byed na ni/ byin rlabs la sogs pa mi dgos la/ gzhan du na 'di la yang dgos te las byed pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'am/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'am/ hūṃ mdzad khams gsum rnam rgyal gang rung du bskyed la/ ye shes pa stim/ mchod cing bstod/ thig skud du bsgyur nas/ 'bru gsum dang hūṃ yig dang rang sngags bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs so/ /thig gi bya ba rdzogs nas/ thig skud kyi lha la mchod bstod phul/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa tshon dbye ba ni thig btab pa'i nang bar yin na/

mngon rtogs rdzogs par sgom pa'am dag pa gsum nas sgrub pa chen po'i bar du sgom/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab nas bzlas pa cung zad bya'o/ /thig btab pa'i nyi ma de nyid la tshon dbye zhing*/ de'i nub mo nyid zin par 'gyur na thig 'debs pa'i sngon gyi bdag bskyed kho nas chog la/ nyi ma de nyid la tshon 'gyed pa'i mgo rtsams kyang*/ nyi ma de nyid la mi 'grub na/ skabs 'dir bdag bskyed mi dgos kyang*/ nang par bdag bskyed byas te dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i 'phro la 'jug go /rdul tshon gyi rgyu ni dur khrod kyi rus pas dkar po/ de'i sol bas nag po/ der skyes pa'i shing los kha bsgyur bas ljang khu/ de'i so phag gi phye mas dmar po/ de dang bab la sres pas ser po'am/ yang na rdul tshon phal pa'am/ rin po che'i phye ma la thal chen sres pa dgos par bshad do/ /gang ltar yang rdul tshon lnga'am/ nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus byas la/ mchod gtor gyi bskor/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying pos byin gyis rlabs pa'i bar/ thig skud byin rlabs dang 'dra ba las/ rdul tshon rnam pa lngar gyur/ zhes 'don pa spos/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi byin gyis rlabs/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor dbus su kha lhor phyogs pas gnas te/

'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgrol byed pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag rtsam/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ gi sngags bzla zhing rtsig pa dkar po nas rtsams te bri bar bya'o/ /tshon gyi kha dog ni phal cher dkyil 'khor spyi'i mtshan nyid rtogs pas shes par 'gyur la/ lha rnams gyi phyogs mdog /shar sngo lho ser sogs yin zhing*/ dbus in+d+ra nī la'i sa gzhi gru bzhi sngon po/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar rnams sngo dkar dmar ba/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mu khyud ser po la/ gri gug gi 'phreng ba nag po'am/ rdo rje'i 'phreng ba bris kyang rung la/ gtso bo'i gnas kyi pad 'dab brgyad ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma'i gnas 'dab ma brgyad ni ser po ste/ phyi nang sdoms pas bde chen 'khor lo la 'dab ma bcu drug yin zhing*/ gtso bo'i gnas kyi ge sar yang ser po bya la/ de'i sna tshogs pad+ma yang ljang khu byas na 'thad dam snyam pa ni rnam par rtog pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rwa ba yang gzhi sngon po la rdo rje ljang khu'i 'phreng bar bya la/ lha'i mtshon ma thams cad ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod de/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad la/ gri gug kho na'am/ yang na 'dab ma bzhi la rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan gyi mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga re'o/ /thugs 'khor ba la rdo rje/ gsung 'khor ba la pad+ma/ sku 'khor ba la 'khor lo'o/ / gzhan yang sa bon dang sngags kyi yi ge 'bri ba dang*/ rkos ma'am lugs su byas pa dang ri mor byas pa'i sku gzugs 'jog pa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi tshom bu dgod pa sogs ji ltar skabs su bab pa dag bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyi rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol la/ dkyil 'khor la g.yon nas lan gsum du bskor nas/

shar lhor yi ge brgya pa dang*/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags bzlas te/ bris pa'i skyon dag par bsam/ rdul tshon gyi lhag ma mchod bstod gshegs gsol bya/ lhag ma'i thig tshon de dag dben pa'i gnas su bzhag go /gsum pa rgyan dang yo byad dgod pa ni/ gzhung las bum pa bkod zin pa'i rjes su gsungs shing*/ don thob kyang de bzhin yin mod kyi/ da lta de skabs byed pa lag len mi bde bas bum pa 'god pa'i gnas bzhag la skabs 'di nyid du byed de/ 'gal ba cung zad kyang med do/ /de yang gzhung las ji skad du/ bla re dag ni bre bya zhing*/ /sna tshogs pa yis gos kyis bre/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs sogs dar rnams kyis/ /gnas dang gnas su rnam par rgyan/ /bum pa bzhag nas mchod pa ni/ /ji skad bshad pa bzhin du bya/ /rin chen gser gyi mdzes par ni/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu gtor bar bya/ /spos snod dag ni brgyad po dang*/ /mar me'i sdong bu'ang de mnyam bya/ /til mar chen pos rab sbar la/ /spos ni lnga po sngon 'gro ba'o/ /sna tshogs me tog 'phyang ba dang*/ /sna tshogs chang dang khu ba kun/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i rab dga' zhing*/ /sna tshogs zhal zas lha bshos dang*/ /sna tshogs rnal 'byor ma pad na/ /dri bzang me tog sna tshogs ldan/ /sna tshogs pa yi glu len zhing*/ /sna tshogs gar gyi gar bzang byed/ /bkra shis sgra ni sna tshogs pa/ /dge ston shrī he ru ka'i/ /spyod pa dang ni grol ba'i gnas/ /'dod pa rnal 'byor ma yi lam/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ rgyud las kyang*/ sgrub po dngos grub gang 'dod kyang*/ /sgron me brgya rnams dbul bar bya/ /zhes sha chen po'i mchod pa dang*/ sgrub po dngos grub gang 'dod kyang*/ /dri dang me tog bdug spos dang*/ /mar me brgya ni dbul bar bya/ /rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /dkar dang nag dang ser skya dang*/ /de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang*/ /me tog phreng ba du ma dang*/ /bla bre dag dang dar dpyangs pa'i/

/mda' dang yol bas shin tu mdzes/ /de bzhin bza' bca' btung ba yis/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas mchod par bya/ zhes dang*/ gser dang dngul lam rin chen dang*/ /mu tig rnams kyis mdzes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu rin chen dang*/ /gser rnams kyis ni mdzes par spras/ /grogs mchog yid 'ong mchod na ni/ /'grub pa nyid du the tshom med/ /bdag nyid thun nas sgo yi ni/ /dṛ yi chu yi legs par gdab/ ces pa dang*/ dril dpyangs me tog spos kyis brgyan/ /shin tu sgra snyan dril bu 'khrol/ /sgrub pa po yi rnga brdung zhing*/ /ha ha zhes ni brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar thig gdab pa nas bzung ste/ 'di dag gi bar gyi nyi ma rnams la/ snga phyi gang yang rung bar/ phur bu rnams la mchod bstod dang*/ ā kā ro'i sngags kyis gtor ma 'bul bar bya la/ dngos gzhi'i nyi ma rnams la ni dkyil 'khor gyi zhor la mchod bstod gtor ma phul bar dmigs pas chog ga'o/ /drug pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs dang*/ zhu 'bul dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/ rgyun bshags yan chad byas la/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la stim/ tshad med bzhi sgom pa yan chad bya'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la sbyang ba ni/ bgegs gtor rnams bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ gtor ma'am 'theb kyu gsum po rim gyis skor la/ oṃ sarba bigh+na bh+yaḥn maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud ga te s+phā ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ te swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ 'dir bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang ldan pas gzhan du dengs shig

zhi bas sbyangs pa'o/ /oṃ sum+bha sogs lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor la/ ting lo'am chang bu bskor/ 'dir bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad/ gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces pa ni/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'o/ /hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas nas bden stobs brjod la/ mthar drag po'i mtshams rngam rol chen dang bcas pas sprad pa ni/ 'di ltar/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi= sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlab kyis/ 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ dbang gi las rim la 'jug pa la/ bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dgadeng dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par myur ba nyid du song shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje dang rdo rje kha ṭaṃ ga 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar dgas par bya'o/ / ces dang*/ sum+bha bzlas pas bgegs bskrad zhing gtor ma phyi rol tu dor te/ drag pos sbyang ba'o/ /bsdus pa la mos na/ bka' bsgo ba yid kyis byas nas sngags tsam brjod de/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying gar yi ge baṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa/

lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis deng ste/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim/ bsangs sbyangs/ 'bar ba'i me'i nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pa pāṃ da ha na bhasm-i ku ru swāhā/ lan gsum brjod las kyi rdo rjes til g.yas g.yon du bskor nas/ g.yas su me dang g.yon du chu dor bas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol ba dang*/ rgya mtsho chen por skyur bar bsam/ mthar me yang chu nang ldugs so/ /sdig pa sbyang ba'o/ /de nas me long bstan te/ las bum blangs nas khrus gsol bya ste/ ji ltar bltams pa= nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ 'di ni khrus mchog= sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs dang*/ sogs kyi rol chen dang bcas pas kyang khrus gsol/ de dag sku la= nas/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.aḥkā ya bi shwa dha na ye swāhā/ zhes sku phyis phul/ spro na dri'i byug pa dang*/ gos dang rgyan yang 'bul te dri ma sbyang ba'o/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i bya ba'o/ gnyis pa la/ sdoms ni/ gzugs brnyan bskyed dang bdag nyid rdzogs/ /bdag mdun bsre dang bum pa sgrub/ /thun mong byin rlabs rnal 'byor sgom/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub tshul rnam lnga'o/ /bskyed dang bdag dran mchod bstod gsum/ /gzugs brnyan bskyed pa'i lag len yin/ /sgom dang bzlas pa mchod pa gsum/ /bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub tshul yin/ /go bgos bsre zhing mchod bstod bya/ /bdag mdun bsre ba'i man ngag yin/ /bum sgrub 'god dang skyong ba 'god/ /bum pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub par 'dod/ /bsre dang go cha dag dran dang*/ /sta gon ye shes dbang bskur ni/ /kun gyi thun mong cho ga'o/ /de yang gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa/ bdag mdun gcig tu bsre ba bum pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa/

thun mong du byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre/ mda'i dra ba ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas/ nas/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'i bar / lha sta gon gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /'on kyang 'dir 'dam kha'i rnam grangs gsungs pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo g.yon ljang rgyab dmar g.yas ser ba'i zhal dang*/ phyag mtshan gyi go rim kyang lū dril gnyis dang mthun pa dang*/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad po phyag bzhi gri gug thod pa ḍā ma ru kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnams 'dzin par dkyil chog las gsungs te/ sgrub thabs las bshad pa dang mi 'dra yang*/ 'dam khar dgongs pa yin la/ des na bdag bskyed la'ang 'di bzhin sgom du rung ba ni yin zhing*/ bdag mdun gnyis po rnam pa gcig kho nar mtshungs pa dgos pa'ang min pas/ ji ltar bde bar sbyor te/ des na bdag mdun gnyis ka la/ ma mo bcu gnyis phyag bzhi par mtshungs pa'am/ gnyis par mtshungs par byas kyang rung la/ sgrub dkyil gyi gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar/ bdag bskyed phyag gnyis pa dang*/ mdun bskyed la bzhi pa'am/ de gnyis go bzlog kyang rung ste/ gtso bo'i zhal phyag la'ang des rigs 'gre'o/ / gang ltar yang de nas lus dang tshor ba zhes sogs bya nga phyogs kyi dag dran bya/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod do/ /gnyis pa ni slob dpon bdag nyid chas su zhugs te/ de thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs ye shes tshogs gsog nas bzung ste bzlas pa rdzogs kyi bar du mngon rtogs bzhin bdag bskyed rdzogs par sgom/ de nas ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/

gsum pa ni/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor sngon bzhin du yid kyis dmigs nas/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi snying khar oṃ oṃ ha/ sogs go cha gsum gyis rgyas gdab/ bdag gis bsgom pa'i lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag gis sgoms pa'i thod pa bzhi gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan phyi rol dur khrod dang bcas pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi thod pa bzhi gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan phyi rol dur khrod dang bcas pa gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ ā hūṃ/ lan sum cu so dgu brjod/ bdag gis sgom pa'i 'byung bzhi ri rab chos 'byung srung 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi 'byung bzhi ri rab chos 'byung srung 'khor dang bcas pa gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ sum+bha lan gsum bzla'o/ / ar+ghṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ bzhi pa ni/ bum pa rgyas pa ltar na/ lha bum sum cu so bdun/ bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad/ las bum ste bzhi bcu rtsa drug go /'bring po ni/ gtso bo yab yum dang 'khor lo lnga la re re/ bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang las bum ste bco lnga'o/ /cung zad bsdus pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa dang bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad/ las bum ste bcu'o/ /shin tu bsdu na rnam rgyal dang las bum mo/ /rnam rgyal bum pa la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang*/ las bum la gri gug 'god/ bkra shis bum pa brgyad la ni/ lha'i mtshan ma ma bkod kyang chog ste/ phyogs mtshams mi nor ba'i rtags tsam ni bya'o/ /bum pa rnams gos zung gis g.yogs/ mgrin par srad bu dkar po skor bdun dkri/ so ba/ mon sran/ nas/ gro/ til dkar te 'bru lnga dang*/ mu tig gser/ mu men/ byu ru dngul te rin po che lnga dang*/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri sle tres dbang lag

chu srin sder mo/ shu thag dkar po ste sman lnga dang*/ gur gum/ ga pur/ tsan+dan/ a kar/ gla rtsi ste dri lnga dang*/ 'o ma/ mar/ sbrang rtsi/ bur ram/ lan tshwa ste snying po lnga'am/ khyad par du me tog mthing dkar ser dmar sngo sangs te me tog lnga dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams oṃ āḥhūṃ bzla bzhin du bum par gzhug dge bas shing gi yal gas kha brgyan par bya'o/ /deng sang lag len la/ bum pa bcu'am gnyis gtso bor byed pas/ bcu yod na rnam rgyal bum pa la bkra shis bum pa brgyad kyis phyogs mtshams nas bskor/ las bum logs su bzhag / rnam rgyal gyi steng thod pa'am/ dung chos mchod yon gyis gang ba dang gzung thag rdo rje yang bzhag go /gang ltar yang mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bum pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma bcu'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du bh+ruṃ rnams las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing*/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul bcings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gi kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ dbus kyi bum pa'i nang du bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog nas bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i shar du mkha' 'gro ma

nas gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol shar phyogs pull̥ rā ma nas nag po'o/ /de'i phyi rol shar= sogs gsung dang sku la'ang 'gre ste/ thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de'i phyi rol shar du khwa gdong ma sogs 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ /shar gyi steng gi mtshan ma hūṃ las he ru ka nag po/ de'i 'og gis mtshan ma maṃ las mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/ byang gi mtshan ma taṃ las lā ma ljang skya/ nub kyi mtshan ma paṃ las khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dmar skya/ lho'i mtshan ma laṃ las gzugs can ma ser skya/ las bum gyi nang dang*/ mtshan ma'i gnas su khaṇ+ḍa ro ha/ sku mdog dmar mo dregs shing khros pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gi ro la gnas pa'o/ / de nas go cha dgod pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams sgrub thabs bzhin du bya ba las/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha la 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod pa'am/ de ni bde chen 'khor lo pa'i nang du tshang bas ma brjod kyang chog go /spros pa la dga' bas bkra shis bum pa brgyad la lha bskyed par 'dod na/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad bskyed par 'os kyang*/ skabs 'dir nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de nas phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs bzhin du bya ste/ 'on kyang nang mchod byin rlabs dang*/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan smos pa dag mi dgos so/ /de nas rdo rje dang 'brel ba'i me tog phreng ba nas bzung ste/ 'di skad ces/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba rnams kha dog dmar po'i tshul gyis spros pa rnams/ gzung thag la 'khril nas song ba/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar reg pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad las mi nyung ba dang*/ 'khor rnams la bdun las mi nyung ba bzlas te rnam rgyal bum pa la'o/

/ sum+bha mang du bzla ste las bum la'o/ /sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags dang yi ge bdun pa bzla ste/ bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad la'o/ /thog ma dang tha mar yum gyi snying po mang du bzla zhing*/ thams cad kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta aṃ bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs par bzla ste bum pa thams cad la'o/ /de nas lha sta gon gyi skabs su 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma 'bul ba ltar/ bum pa'i lha la yang gtor ma 'bul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ zhes sogs kyis/ bzod par gsol mchod yon bum pa rnams su phul te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur/ de nas bum pa la me tog gtor zhing bkra shis brjod/ bdug spos kyi sna drangs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas/ dkyil 'khor la g.yon bskor lan gsum du byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañdzi la sogs pa'i steng du rnam rgyal bum pa 'god/ sgo mtshams brgyad du bkra shis kyi bum pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i g.yas kyi khyams la las bum 'god do/ /de ltar mi bde na/ gzhan rnams rdo rje'i ra ba'i nang tsam du 'god cing*/ rnam rgyal bum pa shar sgor bzhag/bum pa rnams kyi steng du chang dang bdud rtsi lnga dang bza' ba dang bca' ba dang ro sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i thod pa dag bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas ji skad du/ sgo bzhi dag ni rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bo gnyis med dag gis mtshan/ /tshon chen sogs kyis gos dag gam/ /dar la sogs pa dag gis brgyan/ /phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa'i lus/ /rtse bran lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje dril bus yang dag 'khyud/ /sgo brgyad dag tu kha sbyor ro/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo bdag po kun/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i rnam rol yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bum pa skyong ba dang*/

sbyin sreg la sogs pa mchod pa'i don du chas su zhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma brgyad po dag kyang dgod dgos mod kyi/ dngos su med na yid kyi bsam mo/ /lnga pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ bum pa la gnas pa'i ye shes kyi lha rnams mnyam pa nyid kyis rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sarba bī ra yo gi nī/ sogs skad cig rnam pa'i sngags rim pa gnyis ka lan gsum gsum brjod/ lha thams cad kyi snying khar oṃ oṃ ha nas/ tsan ḍi ka'i ngo bo'i bar gyis go cha bkod/ skabs 'dir yang byang phyogs so bdun gyi dag pa dran par bya'o/ /de nas bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pas/ rang gi snying ga nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs phaiṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yo ga shud+dho/ sogs te sta gon gyi lha bsre ba'o/ /slar yang ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba ni sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya ste phal cher sgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ltar bya'o/ /skabs 'dir 'di ltar shes dgos te/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor snying khar bsdus pa'i phyogs 'di rigs la/ snying kha nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor spro ba byas kyang lhag pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur la med kyang chog ste/ gong du bdag mdun bsres pa nyid kyis de'i don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung nas sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs gnyis kar du/ mdun bskyed la dbang bskur byed tshul gsal bar ma gsungs pas byas kyang rung ba tsam yin mod/ cho ga spyi 'gros las don gyi thob pas na byas na legs pa yin no/ /bdun pa mchod pa rgyas pa ni mchod pa spyi dang khyad par gyi mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlab nas mchod pa 'bul ba la/ sdoms ni/ chur bcas nyer spyod dgos zung dang*/

/rig ma bcu drug rin chen bdun/ /'dod yon nang mchod gsang mchod dang*/ /yid mchod bstod pa nyer mkho dang*/ /gsol gdab rdo rje'i glu zhes pa/ /mchod pa'i sde tshan bcu gnyis so/ /dang po chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa ni/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba nas badz+ra pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar/ /dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /me tog de ring bzhes nas su/ /'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ sarba nas badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ swāhā/ oṃ tsan+dan ga bur dang bcas pa'i/ /dri zhim spos me dge ba yi/ /mthu dang ldan par bya ba 'di/ / bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ sarba nas badz+ra dhu paṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā/ oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba 'di/ /ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms par byed/ /lha yi mig 'byed bkra shis pa/ /mar me khyed kyis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba nas badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa/ /sna tshogs ga pur rnam rgyan pa/ /sna tshogs yi ge hūṃ las byung*/ /dri 'di 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba nas badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ oṃ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba nas badz+ra nai we t+ya pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ oṃ pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u sogs/ /dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs dang*/ /yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs rnams/

/'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba nas badz+ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ gnyis pa gos zung 'bul ba ni/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i gos srab pa/ 'jam pa yang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha re re la yang zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba tā tha ga ta shrī tsakra nas/ wī ra yo gi nā badz+ra wasta s+ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ gsum pa rigs ma bcu drug ni/ oṃ wa nī badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo pi waṃ ma/ /ston kha'i mdog mtshungs pi waṃ lag /pi waṃ sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ nam mkha' khyab pa'i mchod par bgyi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra nas wi nī ṇi pū dzi ti āḥhūṃ/ oṃ waṃ se badz+ri ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo gling bu ma/ /gser gyi mdog mtshungs gling bu'i lag /gling bu'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas= oṃ sarba nas waṃ se badz+rī ṇi pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ mṛ taṃ badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo rnga zlum ma/ /ban+dhu'i mdog can rnga zlum lag /rnga zlum sgra dang = nam mkha'= /mṛ taṃ ga= oṃ mu ra dze badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga ma/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs rdza rnga'i lag /rdza rnga'i sgra dang = nam mkha'= mu ra dz+re= oṃ ha s+ye badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo bzhad pa mo/ /king shu'i mdog mtshungs bzhad pa'i zhal/ /'dzum pa'i gzhin dang dbyangs= nam mkha'= ha s+ya= oṃ lā s+ye badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo sgeg pa mo/ /dbang sngon mdog mtshungs sgeg pa'i tshul/ /snyems pa'i lus dang glur ldan pas/ /nam mkha'= lā s+ye/ oṃ girti badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo glu dbyangs ma//'char ka'i mdog mtshungs glu len ma/ /glu dang rol mo'i sgra ldan

pa/ /nam mkha'= girti= oṃ nri ti badz+ri ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo gar mkhan ma/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs gar mdzad ma/ /lag pa gar byed rkang stabs bsgyur/ /nam mkha'= nṛ te= /oṃ puṣ+pe badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo me tog ma/ /gur gum mdog mtshungs me tog lag /me tog char dang rol mo bcas/ /nam mkha'= puṣ+pe= oṃ dhu pe badz+rī ni hūṃ āḥ /rdo rje lha mo bdug spos ma/ /du ba'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos lag /bdug pa'i sprin dang rol mo bcas/ /nam mkha'= /dhu pa= oṃ dī pe badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo mar me ma/ glog 'od mdog mtshungs mar me'i lag /mar me'i 'od dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha'= dī pe/ oṃ gan+dhe badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo dri chab ma/ /pri yang mdog mtshungs dung chos lag/dri yi char dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha'= gan+dhe= oṃ rū pa badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo gzugs mdzes ma/ /ston zla'i mdog mtshungs me long lag /yid 'ong gzugs dang rgyan ldan ma/ /nam mkha'= rū pa/ oṃ ra sa badz+rī ṇi hūṃ aḥ rdo rje lha mo zhal zas ma/ /dza ba'i mdog mtshungs zhal zas lag /zhal zas bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma/ /nam mkha'= ra sa= oṃ spar+sha ṇi hūṃ aḥ rdo rje lha mo na bza' ma/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs na bza'i lag /gos dang reg dang 'khyud par ldan/ /nam mkha'= spar+sha oṃ dharmā du badz+rī ṇi hūṃ āḥ rdo rje lha mo chos dbyings ma/ kun+da'i mdog mtshungs chos 'byung lag/zag pa med pa'i bde ster ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra nas wī ra yo gi ni dharmā dhātu badz+rī ṇi pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ bzhi pa rgyal srid sna bdun ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī tsakra ran+ta pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/

zhes sogs sbyar te/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di 'bul= dbul zhing 'phongs pa rgyun bcad nas/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ ma ṇi= btsun mo rin chen= ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad nas/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs te/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wa sti= blon po= phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan par rab 'dzin zhing*/ /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /mahā sta= glang po= lta ngan rnams ni rab gsal zhing*/ /bla med theg pa rab bzhon nas/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hāsti= rta mchog= srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol nas/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob ste/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog /tu raṃ ga a shwa= dmag dpon= nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ sarba= khat+ga rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ lnga pa 'dod yon lnga ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ / bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ = nas rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra dbyangs ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos= bzhes shig= shap+ta/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*/ /a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos= /bzhes shig= gan+dhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems bltas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos= bzhes shig= ra sa= phyogs dus kun na 'jam gnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ / reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos= /bzhes shig= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta= nas spar+she kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ drug pa nang mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ

rdo rje 'chang chen rang bzhin sku/ zhes sogs/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mngon rtogs ltar phul/ gzhan yang rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i bla ma dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel ba thob pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'i gtso bo yab yum dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rang rang so so'i sngags kyi so sor nang mchod phul ba'i mthar/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yid dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bar 'dir chos skyong gang byed kyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la phul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ ts+tshan+do dang nye ba'i ts+tshan+do/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ mthung spyod dang nye ba'i mthung spyod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du= gzhan yang zhing skyong bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du= gzhan yang gnod sbyin srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du= gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du= gnas bdag grong bdag gzhi bdag gnyug par gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du/

'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim nas/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig de nas bdud rtsi myangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mri ta swā da na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/

bdun pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a nu rā gā ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ lha rnams bde ba chen pos dges par bsam/ brgyad pa yid byung gi mchod pa ni/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi/ zhes pa nas/ bā len tsa swāhā'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /de nas dgu pa bstod pas mchod pa ni/ 'bud dkrol sna tshogs kyi sgra dang bcas te mngon rtogs bzhin rkang brgyad gnyis brjod pa'i mthar/ rdor dril 'dzin pas dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ khyed kyi zhabs gnyis mnyam par mnan na 'og gi klu yang 'jigs 'gyur zhes te thugs rjes zhabs g.yon bskum par mdzad/ /dbu yi gtsug tor drang por bsrangs na tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'jigs 'gyur zhes te dbu ni cung zad yo bar mdzad/ khyod kyi phyag rnams drangs por brkyangs na phyogs skyong rnams kyang skrag 'gyur zhes te thugs rjes phyag rnams cung zad bskum/ /rje btsun khyod kyi sku yi gar ni dgos pa dang ldan mthong bas dad de mchog tu gus pas 'dud/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba 'jigs pa'i gzugs ldan pa/ khros pas 'jigs mdzad mtsho skyes sngon po'i sku mdog bzhin/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng bzhugs kha ṭāṃ ga dang ni/ /rdo rje bsnams shing oṃ oṃ yi ge dag pa yis/ /tshangs pa dang ni khyab 'jug drag po'i lha dag gi /mgo rnams bcad mdzad nas ni dbu la rnam rgyan pa/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ṭa ṭa'i yi ge 'khor ldan pa/ /mi yi seng ge zil mnan nas ni 'jigs mdzad pa/ /thugs rje chen pos sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i tshul bskyed pa/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdapal mo'i nu mar rab tu mnan/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i dbu gtsug la ni rnam rgyan pa/ /lha rnams kun gyi dbu gtsug zhabs kyis mnan bzhugs pa/ /a la la yi sgras ni bgegs rnams skrag mdzad pa/

/cang te'u khrol zhing khyab 'jug drag po'i lpags pa bsnams/ /rdo rje lha mo rnams kyis 'khor lo sgyur mdzad pa/ /hu lu hu lu dz+riṃ dziṃ traṃ traṃ dzaṃ dzaṃ sgrogs/ /rgyu mas brgyus pa'i mgo bo'i phreng ba'i rgyan ldan pa/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gzugs kyis 'jigs byed glur len pa/ /kruṃ kruṃ dang ni hu lu hu lus myos mdzad pa/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros sku la rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /dur khrod du ni gar dang ha la ha la'i sgras/ /gnod sbyin rnams ni rengs shing skrag par mdzad pa de/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yis glus ni rab bskul ba/ /sha dang khrag dang rgyu ma nang khrol gsol bar mdzad/ /haṃ haṃ a a'i sgras ni lha rnams gsal mdzad pa/ /thod pa klad pas bkang nas gsol phyir phyag na bsnams/ /ka ha ka ha'i bzhad sgras 'khor ba 'jig mdzad pa/ /mi bzad dur khrod rnams kyi rus pa'i rgyan ldan pa/ /rdo rje ha har bzhad pas khams gsum brgyal mdzad pa/ /ha ha hi hi dza dza'i yi ge sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /ha ha bzhad pas ri bo'i rtse nas bsgyel mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' rnams hri hri sgrogs pas 'bod/ /mi yi seng ge rtse gsum gyis 'gugs sems can don mdzad pa/ /mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal bzhi sku mdog sngon por ldan/ /bruṃ bruṃ sgrogs shing phyag rgya chen por bskyed mdzad pa/ /rdo rje glo stong 'gyu ba'i ljags ni phyung nas kyang*/ /rdo rje dril bu mda' dang gzhu la kraṃ kraṃ sgrog /g.yon brkyang pa dang sbrul rnams kyis ni dbu brgyan zhing*/ /bskal pa grangs med sems can don byed mi 'dor ba/ /ha na ha na phaṭa phaṭa sgrogs shing skrod mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor stobs kyis rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rnams mdzad pa/ /dngos dang dngos med min zhing sgom dang rdo rje can/ /tsa ṭa tsa ṭa graṃ graṃ khaṃ khaṃ sgrog mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs kyi spros pa stong pa nyid/ /rol pa'i lta bas dri ma ma lus bral ba dang*/

go lu go lu dzaṃ dzaṃ yaṃ yaṃ sgrog pas zhi ba dang*/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin bzhugs pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /maṃ maṃ sgras ni bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /thugs rje chen pos rjes 'brel sems can mi gtong ba/ /brtan g.yo'i rang bzhin he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig a li kā li sbyor ba ste/ /rigs lnga'i bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das kyi bshad du gsol/ /lha dang drang srong rnams ni phyag 'tshal mchod pa yin/ /he ru ka dpal gsang ba'i sku 'dzin der nges 'gyur/ ces dang*/ hūṃ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thabs kyi khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med dbang phyug sku la dbyer med cing*/ /bde chen 'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas la sogs sprin spro ba/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sku la= dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'khor 'das stong par mdzad pa'i thugs rje can/ /gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la= nam mkha' lta bur thams cad thogs med cing*/ /'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ /thugs dam dbang gis sgrub la brtser dgongs pa'i/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la= nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku brnyes te/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo ma lus bcad pa'i phyir/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal gnyis rdo rje'i zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud/ /'jig rten mgon po kun gyi brten 'gyur cing*/ /ye shes las grub mchod pa kun dang ldan/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi la gnas gzhal med khang*/ / bsrung ba'i 'khor lor bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba gnas 'gyur mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /dngos grub kun 'byung dur khrod brgyad po la/ /rab gnas dkyil 'khor pa kun mchod byed dang*/

/de dag rnams la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas bcu pa nyer mkho 'bul ba ni/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dam pa dang*/ /reg na bde ba lha yi gos/ /mkha' lding khyu mchog rma bya dang*/ /glang po rta sogs theg pa'i mchog /dgos 'dod 'byung ba 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo thog dang*/ /dpag bsam shing dang 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /bum bzang nam mkha' gang bas mchod/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum dge ba kun yang 'bul/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i rin chen khri/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan mchog dang*/ /rna rgyan dang ni gdub bu 'am/ /mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang*/ /gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thog /dbu rgyan dar dpyangs do shal bcas/ /rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /dkar dang gnag dang ser skya dang*/ /de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang*/ /me tog phreng ba du ma dang*/ /bla re dag dang dar dpyangs pa'i/ /mda' dang yol bas shin tu mdzes/ /de bzhin bza' bca' btung ba yis/ /rab mnyam gzhag pa'i mchod par bya/ /gser ni brgya stong du ma dang*/ /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang*/ /glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang*/ /chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid/ /bran pho bran mo sring mo dang*/ /blo ldan kun nas dang ba yis/ /bdag nyid kyang ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra u pa s+tha na ni r+ya tad+ya mi/ bcu gcig pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rnal 'byor ro gcig bdud rtsi 'thung bas rnam par dag pa'i thugs/ /gnas la sogs pa'i yul du bgrod pa rnam par dag pa'i gsung*/ /dpal ldan gnas kyi dbus su 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor mgon po mchog /bla ma mchog la mgo bos btud te rtag par phyag bgyi'o/ /de nas zhes sogs dag chen pos/ /rgyud ni rdzogs par gyur pa gang*/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i 'dren pa mo/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /lha mo phreng bas brgyan pa'i sku yi rin po che/ /lus kun dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ma yis rtag tu mdzes/

/'khor lo'i gnas kyi mgon po dri med lhan cig skyes/ /sdom pa'i rnal 'byor snying po la ni rtag phyag 'tshal/ /e yig rnam pa'i snying po khu ba'i gnas gyur pad+ma'i sbubs ni dam pa ste/ /de yi dbus su skyes pa'i ngang mo dam pa kun+da ltar dkar thams cad dag /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas te lha mo mdzes ma'i gzhi/ /dri med lhan cig skyes pa'i gru bzhi 'dren pa la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa dang bral mchog gi lus can ma/ /dmar ba'i 'od chags rnam par rgyal ma khams gsum gzugs can ma/ /yon tan tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i sku mnga' rdo rje'i yan lag ma/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bskyed mdzad ma la rtag tu mngon par phyag bgyi'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtag pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes su chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /rnam par rtog med yang dag rtog /yid ni rab tu mi gnas pa/ /yid la med cing dmigs pa med/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bcu gnyis pa/ dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu dbyangasakyis mchod pa ni/ hūṃ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yi/ /bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /rab tu rmongs pa bsten par byed/ /a la la la la ho/ a i ā/ a ra lī ho/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde/ /a la la la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a i ā a ral+lī ho/ rab dgyes mgon po khyed bzhugs mdzod/ / mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba stsol/

/dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyi gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol/ /thar ba'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /a la la la la ho/ /a i ā a ral+lī ho/ /bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur//bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ /bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur/ /bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /'di yis mgon po bskul na ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub/ /snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blangs pas/ /dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yis/ /gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ zhes glur blangs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mnyes par bsam mo/ /de ltar na thun mong gyi mchod pa thams cad kyis yang dag par mchod do/ /ci ste bsdus pa la mngon par dga' bas kyang*/ bstod pa ma gtogs tshig bcad rnams dor te/ sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gsum 'dzom pa'i sgo nas/ mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bya'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi mchod pa la bzhi/ bzlas pa'i mchod pa/ bya ba'i mchod pa/ tshogs kyi mchod pa/ gtor ma'i mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ las kyi rdo rje lho phyogs su 'dug la/ dbyug gu'i sne la rdo rje btags pas/ lha so so'i gnas su gnod pa med par reg cing*/ sngags mchod bzhin lha thams cad kyi snying po tshar gcig brjod/ thod pa bzhi'i gnas su 'bru gsum tshar re brjod de dang po'o/ /'di ni re re bzhin mang du bzlas na'ang legs so/ /de nas lha thams cad la yum gyi snying po bzla ste gnyis pa'o/ / oṃ kā ka s+yā/ a lu ka s+yā shwa na s+yā/ su ka ra s+yā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'am/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad car gyi sngags bzla ste gsum pa'o/ / oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ā+ai o au aṃ aḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

zhes bzlas te bzhi pa'o/ / oṃ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa hak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ ces pa bzla ste lnga pa'o/ /lha so so'i mtshan dang spel ba'i yi ge brgya pa'am/ de tsam ma lcogs na he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa nyid/ lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi gnas su sbyar bas chog ste drug pa'o/ /byin rlabs bzlas pas 'di'i mthar yang*/ ar+ghaṃ= nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ mthar/ bcom ldan 'das he ru ka dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la me tog dor ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rjes chags kyi gar dang mchod pa'i gar sna tshogs pa rnams dang*/ rgyud las/ bshad pa'i rdo rje glu dang*/ rol mo'i khyad par ji snyed pa dag gis mchod pa'o/ / gsum pa la nang dang phyi rol gyi sbyin sreg gnyis su 'gyur ba las/ nang gi sbyin sreg ni 'khor lo'i mchod pa yin la/ phyi rol gyi yang zhi ba dang rgyas pa gang rung gi sbyin sreg go /phyi nang gnyis kar la rdzas byin gyis brlob pa'i sngags lhag por sngags pa ni/ oṃ sarba badz+ra ga mi ni/ sarba bha k+ṣaṃ sho dhā ya/ gu h+ya badz+ra ṇi hūṃ swāhā/ zhes bya bas so/ /sbyin sreg dang tshogs 'khor ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sgrub thabs dang*/ sta gon gyi skabs su bstan pa ltar/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma 'bul/ gzhan yang spro zhing nus na 'byung po spyi gtor chen mo dang*/ zhing skyong gi gtor ma chen mo dag 'bul lo/ /de la zhing skyong gi gtor ma yang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gnyis las gsungs te/ 'dir ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro bzhin sbyar na legs par mthong ngo*/ /brgyad pa bdag 'jug ni/ rang nyid gtso bo'i mdun zhal gyi sgo dang nye bar 'dug cing*/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa he ru ka phyag gnyis pas las mdzad par dmigs la/'jug pa'i cho ga rnams len zhing*/
