dngos gzhi rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo kho na la dmigs nas so/ /'jug pa'i chos la thog mar dkyil chog gzhan dang mthun pa'i kha skong ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la bden stobs brjod/ /gsol gdab mig dar me tog bzung*/ /gsang gtor bsrung ba dris lan gnyis/ /sems bskyed gsang gdams nang du bzhug /ces sdom tshig blo la nges par bya'o/ /de dag kyang*/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad du gyur/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog lan gsum/ rdo rje phag mos mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab/ oṃ tsak+ṣur ban+dha ba ra ma na ya hūṃ/ gis mig dar bcings/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ gis me tog bzung*/ las bum gyi chus gtor la/ sum+bhas bgegs bskrad/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying ga hūṃ gis srung bar bya/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/

zhes dris pa la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ / zhes lan btab/ slar yang*/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ / zhes dris pa la/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go / zhes lan btab/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro ba/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid do/ /oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ rdo rje snying khar gtad/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ / dkyil 'khor khang pa'am yol ba'i nang du bcug par mos la/ hūṃ dzaḥhūṃ zhes brjod/ de dag ni/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes man ngag spyi dang mthun pa'i kha skong yin la gzhung na med pas bsdu na med kyang chog pa 'ga' zhig yod do/ /de ni dkyil chog 'di nyid las byung ba'i 'jug pa la sdom ni/ sdom pa mdor bstan dam rdzas sbyin/ /srung ba dpa' bo skul ba dang*/ /gsol ba gdab cing gnang ba zhu/ /phyag 'tshal sdom pa sbyin pa dang*/ /dam la bzhag cing ye shes phab/ /nam mkha'i mdog 'dri me tog phul/ /mig dar phye la lta bar bskul/ /lha ngo bstan zhing de nyid brjod/ /ces bya'o/ /de ltar don tshan bcu drug las/ dang po sdom pa mdor bstan ni/ gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bzung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyun ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa dam rdzas byin pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥ ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum sogs bzla bzhin du/ bdud rtsi myang zhing lus la gtor/ gsum pa srung ba ni/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal ba'i/

snying gar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po= nas/ nyi ma'i 'od can no/ /spyi bo la sogs pa'i nas/ si ma ku khams rnams dpa' bo dang rtsa rnams dpa' mo'i bdag nyid du gyur/ bzhi pa dpa' bo bskul ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad he ru ka'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi snying gar thim pas/ mi shigs pa dpyid kyi rtsa thig dpal he ru ka zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ya bid ma he bi d+yā rā dzā ya/ dhī ma he swāhā/ zhes lan lnga'am bdun no/ /lnga pa gsol gdab pa ni/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /don dam smra ba'i seṅge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs chom mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod/ ces lan gsum/ drug pa gnang ba zhu ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ lan gsum/ bdun pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gnas gsum du thal mo sbyor bzhin pas/ oṃ na ma te hūṃ/ na ma me hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas lus thams cad kyis phyag btsal bar mos/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza u pas+tha na āt+ma naṃ nir+ya tad+ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī āt+ma ḍā ki nī a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swā maṃ/ byang sgo nas thal mo snying ga'i g.yon phyogs su sbyar te/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya/ āt+ma naṃ nir+ya tad+ya mi sarba thā ga ta bī ra yo ga nī āt+ma la mā ye a bhi ṣiñtsan+tu maṃ/

nub sgo nas thal mo dpral bar bzhag ste/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi pū dza pra parta na ya āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī āt+ma khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dharmā pra brta ya mi/ lho sgo nas thal mo mgo bor bzhag ste/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza karma ṇaṃ āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī āt+ma rū pi ni karma ku ru maṃ/ zhes so/ /brgyad pa sdom pa sbyin pa la/ sgrags bzung gnyis las/ sgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong*/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum gyi thun mong gi sdom pa bzung*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ / tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge bas chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ / las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ni nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa dag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma rgal ba rnams sgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis bgrol/ /dbugs ma 'byin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces pa lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ zhes pa nas/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bzung gis bar lan gsum gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ngo*/ /dgu pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ /khyod kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/

dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag la/ rdo rje snying gar reg ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ gal te tshul 'di smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ thod pa nas bdud rtsi'i chu btungs te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ / dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭhaḥthaḥthaḥhūṃ/ zhes dam tshig srung ba'i phan yon dang*/ ma srungs pa'i nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag deng nas rtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spang par dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon gyis bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag go bcu pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig/dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba la/ rtsa a wa dhu tī chu shing gi me tog lta bu'i nang na/ dpyid dang thig le kha sbyor bar gnas pa ni/ dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa/ bde ba chen po 'bar ba'i 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ phyogs bzhi maṃ taṃ baṃ laṃ yum bzhi/ mtshams bzhir oṃ yig bzhi thod pa bzhi'i ngo bo/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ pu dza o a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko la ka hi/ pre gri so su na si ma ku rnams dpa' bo nyer bzhi yum dang bcas pa'i ngo bo/ bu ga brgyad la hūṃ ring po brgyad sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi ngo bo/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dpal he ru ka rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ lus kyi stod kyi cha la thugs kyi 'khor lo pa rnams nag po'i rnam pas thim/ bar gyi cha la gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams dmar po'i rnam pas thim/ smad kyi cha la sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams dkar po'i rnam pas 'jug cing*/ gtso bo rigs mar bcas pa dang*/ de ma yin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa yang ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs shing snying gar thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ snying ga'i dpa' bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus thams cad bde ba chen pos gang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las lha tshogs dpag tu med pa char babs pa bzhin tu byung ste snying gar thim/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha mahā kro dhā ā be sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ya bid ma he bid+ya rā dza ya dhī ma he swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags kyang bzla bzhin du/ rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra dang rdzas kyi bdug spos dang bcas pas dbab bo/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhagabacu gcig pa nam mkha'i kha dog bri ba ni bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir mi dgos so/ /bcu gnyis pa me tog 'bul sbyin ni/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes gtso bo 'am rigs mthun pa'i lha la me tog phul/ skabs 'dir/ pra ti gṛh+ṇa/ sogs kyis me tog spyi bor bcing ba/ 'di ni dkyil chog spyi dang mthun pa'i kha skong ste 'dir med kyang chog go /bcu gsum pa mig dar dbye ba ni/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ / mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ

bcu bzhi pa lta bar bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dang ba rab tu bskyed/ /khyed ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*/ /dngos grub kun khyod mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ zhes spro ba bskyed/ bco lnga pa lha ngo bstan pa ni/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing yid kyi dkyil 'khor gsal gdab bo/ /bcu drug pa de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ gzhal med khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yin la/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun yang de rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar bzhugs/ /gnyis med gnyis med pang na gnas/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /spyod dang grol ba rab rtsol ba/ / kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste/ /dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i tshogs/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma lnga po/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs kun/ /'khor lo mkha' la spyod pas bskor/ /rab gtum la sogs yang dag 'khyud/ /gnyis po thugs kyi sprul pa yin/ /myu gu can la sogs pa kun/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad gnyis su med/ /gsung gi rnam dag ngo bo yis/ /mi yi 'jig rten dag tu khyab/ /stobs po che sogs pad gnas pa/ /grub pa sa 'og gnas pa yin/ /sku yi sprul par bshad pa ste/ /chags pa kun gyis rjes su chags/ /he ru ka dpal sogs 'khor lo/ /g.yon nas 'khyud cing nu ma 'dzin/ /sku gsum zhes byas sprul pa ste/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma'o/ kha la sogs pa brgyad po yi/ /gzugs ni rgyu yis yang dag bstan/ /khro bo rnam rgyal la sogs brgyad/ /byang chub sum cu bdun du sprul/ /mkha' la spyod dang sa la spyod/ /sa 'og dag gi ma mo dang*/

/bzhi po mchod pa bzhi yin te/ /lha rnams de nyid mtshon pa yin/ zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa dbang gi ngos bzhi la/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa ste bzhi las/ dang po la rang lugs gzhung don gtsang ma zhib mor bstan pa dang*/ rnam grangs su bstan pa rgya bod kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig 'dod pa'i man ngag gis kha 'gengs tshul gnyis las/ dang po dbang gi sngon 'gro dang*/ dbang dngos gzhi dang*/ mtha' brten te gsum las/ dang po ni/ thog mar slob dpon gyi dbang zhes kyang bya ba bum dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas rtsal/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol zhig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ / sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sku la lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs yongs rdzogs gsal bar gyur/ gzhung las/ he ru ka dpal bdag nyid sems/ dkyil 'khor lus nang chud byas la/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng du ni/ /zhes sogs kyi don no/

/rang nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan g.yon du ba dan/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pas yongs su bskor ba gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang g-i lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pheṃ/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin 'di la gnang bar mdzod/ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la sogs pa khro bo dang khro mo dpag tu med pa spros nas/ bgegs bskrad cing mi shis pa sbyangs par gyur/ yab kyi snying po dang*/ sum+bha bzlas shing rol mo'i sgra sgrags/ dbang rdzas dang gang zag la nyung dkar rdeg cing las bum gyi chus bsangs/ spos kyi bdugs te byur bsal ba'o/ /skabs 'dir gzhung las/ yang na nus pa med gyur na/ /zhes sogs kyi don ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dngos su sprul nus pa'am tshogs kyi dkyil dang yo byad mtha' dag tshang zhing bshams yod na dbang lha spyan 'dren mi dgos te/ rdul tshon la sogs pa'i gnas su sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor ram tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams nyid kyis byur bsal/ shis brjod/ dbang bskur rnams byed par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar mi nus pa'am yo byad med par mos sgom tsam gyi byed pa la ni dbang lha spyan 'dren pa yang dgos shing*/ /dmigs pa'i rtsol ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin no/ / de ltar na dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang*/ dbang gi lha'i gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rdo rje phag mo dang yum bzhis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul/

nam mkha'i dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra sgrags/ me tog gi char phab ste shis pa brjod par gyur/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pas dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis brjod/ bsdu na de ma byas kyang chog cing de'i sho lo ka dang po tsam brjod kyang rung ngo*/ /mthar oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi= zhes sogs kyi dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis dang*/ nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod cing*/ yab kyi snying po mang du bzlas la me tog gtor/ rol chen bya ste shis pa brjod pa'o/ /me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba ni gzhung gi 'gyur dang dpe phal cher las/ lha yi rigs kyi mtshan ma yi/ /me tog ji bzhin gtor bar bya/ /zhes 'byung zhing rim pa gsal ba dang nas gling ma sogs cho ga sgros 'di dang mthun rung 'ga' zhig las kyang bshad pas na/ skabs 'dir me tog 'bul ba nges par dgos pas/ 'di'i 'gyur 'ga' zhig las tshig de med pa ni ma dag par snang la/ 'di dag gis sngags dbang bstan par 'dod pa ni mi legs so/ /de yang me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi lha nges pa can yod na/ der bskyed dgos pa yin kyang*/ de bzhin med na rigs thams cad kyang khyab bdag yin pa'i phyir/ gtso bo nyid du sgom pas chog ste/ des na/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid dpal he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes me tog phul/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phul ba'i me tog de nyid la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po lan bdun sogs mang du bzlas nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍa ki nī sogs dang*/ oṃ dharmā kun da a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes me tog spyi bor bcings/

oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa staṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā pa la/ zhes bdag gi slob ma rigs kyi lha la gtad par mos/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ gtso bo he ru ka yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/ lus thams cad rang rigs kyi lha'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ zhes so/ /skabs 'dir ba spu'i bu ga nas sangs rgyas rnams stim ste lus nang gang bar byed pa 'di/ gzhung las me tog dbang bskur la sogs pa thams cad cho ga bzhin sbyin zhing*/ dkyil 'khor lus nang chud par bya/ zhes gsungs pas bstan te/ bla ma gong ma rnams dang nā ro pa'i man ngag 'dzin par grags pa'i lo tsā ba rnams 'di la nang dbang gi tha snyad mdzad la/ 'on kyang spyi skad la slob ma bur bya ba la nang dbang du grags ches pa dang*/ 'khrul gzhi 'byung nye ba'i phyir/ lus nang byin gyis brlobs pa'i dbang bskur zhes bya yi nang dbang gi tha snyad sbyar bar mi bya'o/ /'di chu dbang sogs re re bzhin la yod par thams cad mthun la/ 'on kyang mal lugs pa dang*/ rwa lugs pa rnams dbang so so'i rjes la byed cing*/ mar do dang lo chung phyogs rnams/ de 'og rnam rgyal bum pa dang*/ zhes sogs gzhung tshig gi don du bsams nas/ /thog mar 'di sbyin nas de'i rkyen gyis slob ma lhar bskyed par 'dod de lugs snga ma de legs so/ /'on kyang lus nang gtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ mkhas pa'i cho ga bzhin dbang bskur/ /zhes pas ni/ slob ma bur bya ba'i nang dbang nyid bstan gyi cig shos min pas/ dkyil 'khor lus nang chud par bya/ /zhes pa dang don mi gcig go /de nas chu dbang ni/ / swa bha was sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' mi bskyod pa yab yum spyan drangs/ phaiṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ /de zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ skabs 'dir rgyas pa la spro na dbang rdzas dbang bskur ba dang*/ mchod bstod bzlas pa sogs kyang bya la/ bsdu na ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa yang ma byas pas chog ste/ dkyus su bstan pa ni 'bring po'i dbang du byas pa'o/ / gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad sprul/ bkra shis kyi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi= nas/ khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ ka ka s+yai/ u lu kā s+yai/ shwa na s+yai/ su kā ra s+yai/ ya ma dan ḍhi/ ya ma du ti/ ya ma daṃṣ+ti ni ya ma ma tha nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog /lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis drangs te zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkha' nang du babs/ oṃ swa bhā wa= sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang ba'i yum la 'khyud pa/ rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa skad cig gi grub par gyur/ dpral par oṃ nas/ thugs kar hūṃ gi bar gong bzhin/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zhal du zhugs/

byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste/ rang la gnyis su med par thim pa'i tshul gyis dbang bskur/ huṃ zhes mkha' nang nas phyir spros te dbang stegs la 'khod par gyur/ dkyil 'khor dang dbang gi lha rnams la dmigs nas/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i lha thams cad kyis/ thod par rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu blug pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūṃ/ zhes pa'i dbang bskur/ bkra shis kyi bum pa logs su med na/ snga ma la rnam rgyal nas bum chus gtor ba tsam bya'o/ /de ltar na bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi skyod pa'i dbu brgyan/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/ lus thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dgarnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no/ /mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ / skabs 'dir gzhung las/ he ru ka dpal bdag nyid sprul/ /spyod dang brtul zhugs brtan pa dang*/ /de bzhin gnyis med tshangs spyod brtan/ /zhes dang*/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor rnams kun/ /sgoms nas thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas dbang rdzas rigs lnga so sor dmigs pa 'pho ba yin gyi/ slob ma'am bdag 'jug la rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal kho na la gnas dgos pa dang*/ thams cad dbang bskur zhes pas lus dkyil 'khor lha thams cad la dbang bskur ba gsal ba'i phyir/

lus dkyil gyi mos pa tsam bsgom dgos pa'ang yin no/ /cod pan gyi dbang ni/ swa bhā wa/ dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po/ g.yas rin po che dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu= nas/ drug gis brgyan pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang= nas/ 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum spyan drangs=nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang*/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur byin par bya/ zhes so/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje yang dngos su sbyin pa'am yid kyis bsam/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī/ sogs yum gyi snying pos dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs bcings/ oṃ ka ra ka ra ku ru ku ru/ nas/ dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings/ oṃ kā ka s+ya/ sogs dang*/ gtso bo'i snying po brjod la/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur=nas/ yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ de nas lus nang byin gyis brlob pa'i dbang bskur ni/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ rin chen 'byung ldan dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar na dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag /tshor ba gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du gyur pa'i skal can du byas pa yin no/ / de ltar na chu cod gnyis las dpag te 'og ma gsum la rigs 'gre ba ni/

ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren dang*/ dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba dang*/ rigs bdag rgyas 'debs dang*/ lus nang byin gyis brlob pa'i dbang bskur gyi skabs rnams su/ mi bskyod pa'am rin chen 'byung ldan dpag tu med pa zhes dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab zhes dang*/ dbang gi dag pa'i skabs kyi/ mi bskyod pa'am rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags zhes pa'i gnas su/ 'od dpag med sogs kyi mtshan 'jug cing*/ lhag mthong go rim thams cad snga ma bzhin du bya ba yin no/ /de la rdo rje'i dbang ni 'di ltar/ dbang rdzas rdo rje 'od dpag med dmar po/ pad+ma dang yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes rdo rje lag tu bzung ba'am gtod cing*/ slob ma dbang bskur na gzhan yang gri gug dang 'khor lo la sogs pa/ mtshan ma rnam pa du ma sbyin par bshad do/ /de nas rdo rje de nyid lan gsum du gsor nas snying gar gtod de/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag ces brjod cing*/ sems nyid mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen por shes pa ni/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid 'dzin pa'o/ / de nas sngar bzhin brtan byed chu dbang bskur ba sogs bya/ rdo rje'i dbang*/ 'dod chags/ 'du shes/ so sor rtog pa'i/ zhes sogs 'don pa spo/ dril bu'i dbang ni 'di ltar/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ don yod grub pa ljang khu/ ral gri dang*/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/

/byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dril bu lag tu gtad/ lan gsum mam brgyad du dkrol/ khang nang du bstan te dku g.yon pa'i thad du bzung ba'am bzung du gzhug / srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par gyur/ zhes brjod cing*/ ngag chos nyid don gyi sgra/ gzhom med kyi nā dar shes par byed pa ni/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid do/ /bstan byed sogs gong bzhin las/ dril bu'i dbang*/ phrag dog 'du byed/ bya ba grub pa'i zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /de nas phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba ni/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang snang bas yum rdo rje phag mo lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu la yang dag par 'khyud pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya chen po yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ rtsa ba'i gtso mo bzhi dang*/ thig le ni rdo rje phag mo/ dpyid kyi rtsa khams ni dpal he ru ka rtsa sum cu rtsa bdun ni rnal 'byor ma sum cu so bdun/ khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ thams cad kyang gsal zhing dwangs la bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ kha sbyor dang 'khyud pa dang bzhad pa las byung ba'i dga' ba'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid do/ / yid kyi lus brten de nyid ni/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu sgrags/ /shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung cig rdo rjer byin gyis brlob/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdud par gyis/

lus rnam pa thams cad pa rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid du shes pa ni/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig go /zhes dang*/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po mang du bzlas te byin gyis brlab bo/ /'di ni dril bu'i dbang gi rjes 'brang ma yin/ dril bu'i dbang dang 'di sdom pa la bdag po'i dbang zhes bya ba dbang gcig tu byas pa yin zhing*/ ming gi dbang ni sku byin gyis brlab pa 'di brtan byed kyi tshul du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas ming gi dbang bskur ba ni 'di ltar/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu/ rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang*/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ shrī he ru ka nā ma/ a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal gsang mtshan dran par bya/ sngags brjod skabs rdo rje dril bu spyi bor 'jog /de'i skabs su rnam snang spyi bor byon te/ yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba'i/ ye shes chen po'i 'od zer gyis/ lus thams cad gang bar mos dgos pa yin no/ /brtan byed sogs gong bzhin las/ ming gi dbang*/ gti mug /gzugs phung*/ chos dbyings kyi/ sogs 'don pa spo/ de nas sngags dbang ni/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ bdag gi snying gar thim/ zhes dang gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po tshar gsum bzlas te rjes bzlos byas par mos/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ rang gi spyi bor me tog bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlob/ me tog gtor la/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ sngags dbang 'di gzhung las rgyas bshad kyi skabs su/ phyag rgya'i dam tshig dang*/

ming dbang gi bar du gsungs/ don bsdu'i skabs su ming dbang gi rjes su gsungs pas gnas skabs gnyis po gang rung byas kyang 'dra'o/ /brtul zhugs la gnyis las/ thun mong ba rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ swa bha wa/ dbang rdzas dang po'i rdo rje/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ/ dha ra ya mi hūṃ ha ha ha ha ho hi/ rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka bzhugs par gyur/ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa brtul la rdo rje sems dpa'i tshul la zhugs shing*/ rdo rje lag tu gtad la snying gar gtugs/ thun mong ma yin pa'i spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ rang nyid skad cig gi 'khor lo bde mchog /zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ rang gi snying gar yang rang dang 'dra ba'i he ru ka hūṃ las byung ba'i cang te'u/ thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ ga /tshangs skud rnams su gyur/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭ+waṃ cang te'u lhung bzed dag /byin pa dpa' bo'i bzung bar gyis/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang ḍa ma ru/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+waṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+waṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ ḍa ma ru ni shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrog pa/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga ni thabs rig pa byang chub kyi sems lha'i sku/ thod pa bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa rnam par mi rtog pa thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yin pas na/ de ltar shes par gyis la sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'o/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad/

bdag nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ kā ka s+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor zhing rol mo sgrags te brtan bzhugs bya/ gong bzhin mchod pa'am/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas bdag nyid la mchod do/ /de ltar na ji skad du/ me tog chu yi dbang bskur dang*/ /cod pan rdo rje bdag po dang*/ /ming dang sngags dang brtul zhugs dang*/ /zhes pa ltar dbang brgyad po de dag ni/ bum dbang gi dngos gzhi yin la/ 'di rnams mtha' brten gyis dbang dang bcas pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ste/ dbang 'di dag las/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa bor nas/ rigs pa'i dbang lnga'i mthar/ rjes gnang gi khyad par 'ga' zhig dang*/ dam tshig sbyin pa ci rigs pa tsam byed pa ni/ slob ma kha cig skye ba 'di la rdo rje slob dpon gyi gnas thob par mi 'gyur ba dag la sbyin par bya ste/ de ltar na de tsam zhig rdo rje slob ma'i dbang du 'gyur gyi/ bum dbang gi cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa gcig gi cho ga'i stod smad la slob ma dang slob dpon gyi dbang dum bu gnyis su dbye ba ni/ gzhung 'di'i dgongs pa ma yinazhing*/ 'di dang cho ga sgros mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga grub pa'i slob dpon gzhan gyis mdzad pa mang po las kyang mi 'byung ngo*/ /des na skabs 'dir slob dpon gyi dbang zhes bya ba ni/ slob dpon du 'gyur ba la bskur bar bya rgyu'i bum dbang spyi'i ming du bzhed kyi/ slob ma dang slob dpon gyis dbang zhes slob ma gcig la bskur bya la so sor phye ba'i nang gi slob dpon gyi dbang ni ma yin no/ /mtha' brten gyi dbang ni ji skad du/ gnang dang dam tshig gzengs bstod dang*/ /de bzhin lung bstan dbugs dbyung dang*/ /zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ dang po rjes gnang gi dbang la lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang de kho na nyid kyi rjes gnang*/

sems can gyi don gyi rgyu'i rjes gnang*/ chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang*/ las dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjes gnang dang lnga'o/ /de la lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ deng nas rtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang*/ /shes rab thabs bcas snyems can gyis/ /gar mchod bde ba'i dga' ston gyis/ a/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phangs/ /sangs rgyas kun tshogs rnal 'byor ma/ /de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ oṃ/ /lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /de'i ni rnal 'byor ma de dang*/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ gī/ /de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ ho/ sangs rgyas kun la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yis/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ bh+ruṃ/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par 'gyur/ a/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldongs rnams la/ /ye shes sgron me sbar bar gyis/ pra/ khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ /rnal grol ye shes mthong ba yis/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ ga /de kho na nyid kyis rjes gnang ni/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hri/ sems can gyi don gyi rgyu'i rjes gnang ni me mong bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/

/rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skyes/ chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar gyis/ /khyed kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ las sgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*/ /gsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*/ /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yis dngos grub ni/ / de ni ci dgar sgrub par gyis/ gnyis pa dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ nang par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas kyang*/ /bsrung dang bza' ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid kyis bsrung ngo*/ /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa srung*/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzlas par bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re srung ba ni/ / gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lor gnas/ /tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ / chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ / thams cad gnyis med pang na gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang mi spong zhing*/ /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ /khyed kyis brnyes par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya gzhon pa mtshon cha dang*/ /mtshan ma 'god par mi bya'o/ /dam tshig rab srung bsod nams kyis/

/tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing*/ /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang*/ / lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ bdag bu khyod ni ma yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gis 'o mas skyongs/ /gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i/ /bslab pa blangs pa sngon 'gro bas/ /sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu srung*/ /dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid/ /spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ zhes sgrags pa la/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa gzengs bstod pa ni/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /tshangs par spyod pa rtag mnos la/ /'dod pa lnga la spyad par gyis/ /gnyis med la gnas zas la ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brdas/ /gnyis med pa dang thogs med par/ /dam tshig spyad pa spyod par gyis/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyad cing*/ /tshangs spyod bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /khro ba med pa'i rgyun gcod pa/ /sgrub pa po ni yongs su srung*/ /rtag tu sgrub la gnas nas ni/ /yul kun tu ni rnam rol ba/ /gnyis med sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mi brtan srog ni ji srid bar/ /bu khyod kyis ni sgrub par bya/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci dgar bar ni longs spyod cig /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /bsam nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi dngos/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/

/ zhes so/ 'dir bsrung ba'i dam tshig go /zhes 'byung ba'i srung ba ni skyong ba'i don te/ rig brtul gyi spyod pa'i dam tshig dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig dang*/ gsang ba'i dam tshig gi sgo nas/ rnal 'byor chen por sngags pa yin pas 'di nyid kho na gzengs bstod kyi don ni/ bzhi pa lung bstan pa'i dbugs dbyung ba ni/ he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin/ /mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ / he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /he badz+ra aṃ ku ri shrī he ru ka nā ma sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa mā ya s+t+waṃ bhur bhu ba swa/ gang la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis don grub pa'i phyag rgyar gnas pa la/ mchog tu grub pa'i tshogs rnams mgrin gcig tu rgyal ba thams cad kyi lung bstan par mdzad do/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa dang*/ /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /der ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyed rnams the tsho med pa yin/ /dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yis/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ zhes pa'o/ de rnams kyis ni dkyil 'khor las rdul tshon nam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ / zhes dag pa dran par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bla ma'i man ngag gis kha 'geng ba'i lugs ltar na/ rig pa'i dbang gi skabs su dam tshig gsum mi sbyin/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi mthar/ brtan bzhugs mchod pa rnams spang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rdo rje hūṃ las byung ba'i rdor sems kyi ngo bor

mos/ 'di ste sangs rgyas sogs dang*/ thog mtha' med pa'i= sogs kyis rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig bzung*/ dril bu a las byung ba'i snyems ma'i ngo bo/ mos/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun= sogs brjod/ rang nyid rdor sems yab yum du bsgom nas/ yid kyi lus brtan/ sogs chu dbang bskur/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ dbang lha stim/ mchod cing brtan bzhugs byas nas/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ zhes sogs bka'i gnang ba sbyin pa ste/ lū yi pa'i dkyil chog tu rnam par phye zin pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang 'di ni gzhung don dang cung zad mi 'grig pas dkyus su bshad pa nyid bya'o/ /gzhan yang pham thing ba dang rwa lo'i man ngag la/ rig pa'i dbang gi lus nang byin gyis brlob pa'i dbang gi skabs/ sangs rgyas rnams gang la stim pa'i gzhi ni/ chu dang ming la spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i oṃ dang*/ u rgyan dang dril bu la spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje'i dbang la/ mgrin par pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa sogs bzhed de/ man ngag yin pa'i phyir de ltar yang mi 'gal mod/ gzhung gi dgongs pa ni dkyus su bstan pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te/ gsol ba btab par mos/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ sngags dang phyag rgya phul nas/

kun rtog thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /ye shes sku khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba'i mi shes bcad nas su/ /de nyid dag pa'i don ston mdzad/ /bdag med chos las kun tu byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan dag /mgon po khyod las byung ba ste/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkon mchog gsum dang theg pa che/ khams gsum 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /brtan dang g.yo ba khyod las byung*/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba'i 'dod don dngos grub rnams/ /yid bzhin nor bu ltar 'byung zhing*/ /dpal ldan bde gshegs ye shes gnas/ /sangs rgyas sras la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ ces lan gcig gis bstod/ bdag 'jug kho na la 'di ma byas kyang chog go /de nas 'di skad ces/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyod mthu yis/ /de nyid bla med shes par 'tshal/ /rdo rje dbang bskur kun mkhyen gyis/ /bka' drin de ring bdag la gsol/ /bcom ldan khyod zhabs pad+ma ni/ /spangs nas gzhan na skyabs ma mchis/ /'khor ba'i 'gro ba spang pa'i phyir/ /de bas mgon pos brtse bar mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun la gsang ba che/ /ji ltar dpal ldan thugs rdo rjes/ /rdo rje chos ni bstan pa bzhin/ /mgon pos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab bo/ mig dar bcings 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi gtor la srung ba bya/ slob dpon rig ma dang bcas pa dpal he ru ka yab yum du gyur pas/ 'di skad ces/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang*/ /dmang rigs mthar skyes bud med kun/ /gus dang bcas pas mchod pa dang*/ /gnyis med tshul gyis tsum pa ni/ /dpa' bo khyod ni spro gyur tam/ zhes dris pa la/ ci gsungs dam tshig bsten par ni/ /lha mo bdag gis byed par nus/ / zhes lan btab par mos/

slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje dang*/ rig ma'i zhabs g.yon rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang*/ /dmangs rigs tha ma dag spyad cing*/ /pad+ma'i bha gar tsum pa dang*/ /bdud rtsi rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ zhes bka' bgos/ bdud rtsi gtor nas srung ba bya/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i byang chub kyi sems bdag gi lce thog tu bzhagaji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ / yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi myang*/ yum gyi byang sems myangs par mos la/ gong bzhin brjod la bdud rtsi myang*/ ā ho mahā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bsal/ dam tshig sgrags pa ni/ khrag chen po ni ga bur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar dang yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i chu dang bcas/ /lnga pa sems las byung bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /dam tshig 'di ni bla na med/ /bzang po khyod kyis bskyar bar bya/ zhes so/ de lta na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob pas ngag gi dri ma dag lam bzlas pa dang rlung bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kyai/ rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya bsgrubs pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*/

/bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyob/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mig dar bcings rig dang mthun pa'i phyag rgya gtad/ 'di ni byang chub sgrub rnal 'byor/ khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor pas/ /yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis/ / bdag nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa dang*/ phyag rgya rdo rje phag mor gyur/ sgrub thabs bzhin mkha' gsang byin rlabs dang*/ yab yum gnyis kyis gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ gnas lnga byin rlabs rnams bya/ sangs rgyas thams cad bkug nas/ bdag nyid rig mar bcas pa la thim/ yab yum snyom bar zhugs pa'i dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes brtan par byas/ dang po kun dga' dpa' bo ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnal 'byor ma/ /rab tu dga' ba ma lus nyid/ /de bde thabs las thams cad rig /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gdong g.yogs dkrol/ srog chags bsad par mi bya ste/ /bud med rin chen smad mi bya/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ zha ེsa so/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas/ sems kyi dri ma dag lam dngos sam ye shes kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bdag la bka' drin skyabs du gsol/ lan gsum/ de ltar yang*/ zab cing rgya che la mos na/ tshig gis rin chen dbang bskur bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bzhi pa'i ye shes ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las/ pho nya lhan cig skyes grub ni/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ste/ /yid ni nang du chud pa yis/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub sgom par bya/

ces dang*/ bshad pa'i rgyud las kyang*/ dngos dang dngos med bral ba yi/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pas sgom bya/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol ba/ / sgom na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ rgyud gzhan las kyang*/ ye shes 'di ni che phra zhing*/ /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyis pha ni khyod nyid do/ / zhes bsam gyis mi khyab pa lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid/ sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ gnyis med ye shes dbang bskur ni/ /gsang ba kun la sogs par bshad/ /ces gzhung las gsungs shing*/ de mtshon par byed pa ni phyag rgya gtad pa'i dbang bskur shes rab ye shes so/ /dam tshig sgrags pa ni/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang khyod kyis long*/ /pha rol bud med bsten par bya/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag sgo gsum mi phyed pa rdo rje lta bur gyur/ lam bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa sgom pa la dbang 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / dbang rnams kyi thun mong du rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ byang chub snying po'i mthar thug par/ /chos kyi 'khor lo kun tu ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa/ /kun nas rab tu skor bar gyis/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin du/ /skye med dgos dang bral ba yis/ /da ni sems can don rnams kyis/ zhes so/ / gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ sogs lan gsum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul te/ deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da 'gyur to/ / zhes dang*/ deng nas brtsam te/

sogs dge ba bsngo'o/ /dgu pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ phal cher bdag 'jug gis rigs 'gre ba yin la/ slob ma rnams gral du 'dus ma thag tu/ dkyil 'khor la byed pa bzhin bgegs sbyang rgyas pa de bya/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skabs kyi sdom pa mdor bstan dang*/ dam rdzas sbyin pa song mtshams su/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi sogs brjod/ phyogs bzhi phyag 'tshal gyis skabs/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags kyis khrid nas sgo phye ba yin te/ dang por/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces phyi rol nas slob ma khrid par mos/ sngags de nyid dam badz+ra ud gha ṭa 'i sngags kyi sgo phye nas/ shar sgo'i phyag 'tshal byed pa sogs te gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i sbog chog ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rdo rje rgya gram dmar po las 'od 'phros shangs bug g.yas nas thon slob ma'i sna bug g.yas nas zhugs/ dpral par rdo rje rgya gram dmar po 'od 'phro bar gyur/ ye shes sems dpa' ā li kā li'i rnam par spyan drangs te stim pas/ lus kyi nang sngags kyi yig 'brus gang ba la sems gtad de/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ des kyang ma phebs na spyi bor bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i 'od zer gyis lus kyis nang gang bar bsam pa'o/ /zhes pa bla ma rnams kyis man ngag go /ye shes phab pa brtan byed byas ma thag tu nam mkha'i kha dog dris nas/ kha tog dang mthun pa'i las dang dngos grub kyang lung ston pa dgos so/ /lha ngo bstan pa la nges par mngon rtogs rgyas par ston dgos la/ byur bsal ba'i sngon du/ bgegs sbyang ba byas kyang rung zhing legs la/ 'dir byas na gong du bgegs sbyar ba mi dgos so/ /gang ltar yang bdag 'jug gi skabs su bshad pa'i byur bsal ba de song ma thag tu/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sdig pa sbyang ba nges par byed dgos so/ /shis brjod kyi skabs su 'grub na/

sha dang*/ chang dang*/ gong bu dang khu ba'i rdzas sna tshogs pa byin gyis rlabs te/ slob ma'i mtha' yang bskor/ dbang gi lha rnams la gtor ma'i tshul du 'bul ba yang bya zhing*/ gang ltar yang rnam rgyal bum pa bteg cing mchod pa sna tshogs dang bcas nas bya'o/ /spro zhing nus na slob dpon dang slob ma'i lus dkyil gsal 'debs pa'i skabs kyang rgyas par brjod na legs so/ /'di dag zhib mor lag len dang ngag rgyun las shes par bya'o/ /khyad par dngos su dbang stegs 'cha' thub na shin tu legs te dkyil chog thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin la/ khyad par gzhung 'di las slob ma'ang rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa sogs chas su 'jug par bshad do/ /ming dbang skabs ming 'dogs pa la/ bzhad dang sgeg rol ngo mtshar zhe sdang dang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje sogs/ rdo rje'i rigs med de nyid bud med la/ /bdag med ngo mtshar bde ma sgeg mo'o/ /ye shes rtag pa gti mug rnam snang dang*/ /sgyu 'phrul sku dang sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /rnam snang rigs yin de bzhin bud med la/ /rdo rje spyan ma mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma/ /yan lag med dang dga' ba shin tu bde/ /gzi brjid snang byed rdo rje rin chen la'o/ /bud med la ni rdo rje 'bar ma dang*/ /mgyogs ma ro langs ma dang lcags kyu ma'o/ /pad+ma pad myug 'dod chags 'jig rten mgon/ /pad+ma gar dbang dang ni rdo rje chos/ /pad+ma'i rigs la'o rdo rje phreng ba ma/ /sgeg mo bzhad mo 'khyud ma bud med la'o/ /nam mkha' shes rab myu gu rta mchog dang*/ /don yod don yod grub pa las kyi ste/ /rdo rje sgrol ma gar ma kong ka na/ /do shal ma ste las rigs bud med do/ /rnam rgyal dpe med ro mnyam bde chen dang*/ /dam pa dang po phyag na rdo rje ni/ /rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi skyes pa'i ming*/ /rdo rje snyems ma rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma sogs bud med/

gzhan yang me tog gang la phog pa yi/ /mtshan yang ji ltar 'os pa gdags su rung*/ /rgyas par rdo rje gur las shes par bya/ /zhes bya'o/ /spyod pa'i brtul zhugs rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bcu pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ sbyin sreg dang 'khor lo'i mchod pa sogs byas nas/ yang dkyil 'khor la mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ byin gyis brlabs/ mchod yon sogs sngags tsam mam tshigs bcad dang bcas pas kyang rung ste phyi mchod phul/ rig ma bcu drug dang nang mchod dang gsang mchod rnams sngags tsam gyis bya/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis thugs dgongs rdzogs shing*/ zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang*/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ lho phyogs nas yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sam/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol lo/ /bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa dang*/ yo byad ma tshang ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa thams cad kha skong zhing*/ bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi las dang dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo/ /ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yin nam/

ma yin kyang rten gzhan yod na brtan bzhugs bya ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la/ zhes sam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la zhes sam/ sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la/ zhes gang 'os skabs dang sbyar te/ bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad/ ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes me tog gtor/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin la gzhan rten sku sogs med cing*/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel byed pa'i skabs/ nyi ma snga ma rnams la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brten par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

zhes pa tsam gyi brtan bzhugs bya/ rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi nyin mo de yang mi dgos so/ /de nas gshegs gsol ni/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes te zhag sbrel mar byed pa'i nyi ma snga ma rnams la ni/ rten la ma brten pa'i mgron kho na [ de yang ] gshegs su gsol ba yin zhing*/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i skabs yin na/ de steng du bum bskyed kyang gshegs dgos la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i dus ni dkyil 'khor ba yang gshegs pa yin te/ de yang badz+ra muḥ yan gyis mgron rnams gshegs/ bum bskyed dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha ni gtan las 'phags te nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes rnam lnga 'dod skor dang*/ 'khyud rgya byas pas/ de rnams rang nyid la thim par mos/ de ltar lan gsum byas nas rdo rje'i rtse mos rtsig pa dang thig gi lam dbye zhing*/ lha mtshan rnams logs su bsdu don du gnyer ba nyid na cung zad sbyin/ rdul mtshon rnams bum pa la sogs par blugs te/ bkur bsti dang bcas pa'i chu bor spyan 'dren/ rdul tshon klu la gtad/ bum par chu bo de nas chu blangs te/ thig rnams bsrubs/ phur bu dbyung ngo*/ /de dag gi cho ga gzhan ni spyi dang mthun la/ phur bu ni rang rang gi sngags kyis bton la/ shul du mar dang sbrang rtsis byug mthar smon lam mang du gdab/ bkra shis rgya cher bya'o/ /ras bris kyi phyogs la ni/ brtan bzhugs byas ma thag tu smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ spyod 'chang zhabs kyi gzhung lugs rtogs dka' te/ /phyogs 'dir 'grel brtsams pa mang yod kyang*/ /rnam bshad phal cher 'khyog po'i lam du 'dren/ /dkyil chog rnams kyang rang bzo'i bzlos gar sgyur/

/dgongs 'grel sgyu ma mkhan po'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /don gnyer skye bo'i blo mig lan brgyar bslangs/ /rang rang mthun phyir gzhung tshig dkrug pa dang*/ 'khyog bshad mang pos gzhung bzang dri mar byas/ mkhas mchog rdo rje 'dzin par grags 'gas kyang*/ /'di don ji bzhin gsal bar ma rtogs na/ /phrag dog can gyi blun po mkhas 'dod 'gas/ /'di don shes su re ba ha cang 'khrul/ /de slad nag po'i dgongs don ji bzhin du/ /dag cing gsal la ma 'khrugs go bde ba/ /mdor bsdus tshig gis gzhung chen shes pa 'di/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug gang de'i smon lam mthu/ /'di las dge ba gang zhig thob gyur pa/ /de ni 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /bdag kyang 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /srid par gnas nas sems can don sgrub shog /ces slob dpon chen po spyod pa pa'i lugs kyi/ dkyil 'khor cho ga'i lag len gsal byed bde ba chen po'i char yangs zhes bya ba 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o/ /lū yi pa'i dbang chog kyang nag po spyod pa'i dkyil chog la gzhi gdan byed phyin chad/ dkyil chog gzhan dang go bstun ma sbyar bar/ 'dir bshad pa kho na bzhin byas na yang shin tu legs pa yin no/ /dge legs 'phel// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil chog nag po lugs kyi gsal byed bde ba chen po'i char yangs bzhugs/ -PAGE 86--PAGE 91--PAGE 77-
